description: A British safecracker goes to prison but after World War II begins, he's recruited by army intelligence and is sent to German-occupied Belgium to crack the safe of a German Abwehr unit located in a chateau.

Title: 359. Point and Line
description: A senior detective is determined to find the truth behind an apparent double suicide.

Title: 360. The Heart Is a Rebel
description: Hal and Joan Foster hire Gladys, a nurse/caregiver, to look after their son who has a life-threatening heart problem. Joan is invited to hear Gladys sing with her church choir at a Billy Graham Crusade inside Madison Square Garden. Conflict arises as Hal is confused about Joan's decision for Christ. Ethel Waters sings "His Eye Is On The Sparrow" and the spiritual "Motherless Child."

Title: 361. U47 - Kapitänleutnant Prien
description: In 1939 German U-boat captain Günther Prien receives orders to infiltrate the British Royal Navy base at Scapa Flow and sink British warships.

Title: 362. Young Husbands
description: A movie about the mixed feelings of young adulthood. Main characters rather casually enter into marriage, never intending true fidelity to their spouses. When they realize that they're committed for life, the immature boy-husbands return to their hometown for one final fling.

Title: 363. Violent Road
description: Truck drivers take cargo of explosives over bumpy mountain road.

Title: 364. Suicide Battalion
description: During the Japanese invasion of the Philippines, an American commando team is sent to an evacuated American base in the jungle to destroy classified documents.

Title: 365. Nadodi Mannan
description: A wanderer/revolutionary is a dead ringer for a monarch, and takes his place.

Title: 366. Der Pauker
description: Dr. Hermann Seidel is an authoritarian teacher at a small town high school.After the dislocation to a big town school, he sees himself and his concept of education, put to a severe test.

Title: 367. Sigfrido
description: Legendary hero Siegfried uses a magic sword to fight a huge, fire-breathing dragon.

Title: 368. Camping
description: The two young lovers Tao and Valeria decide to go and enjoy a beautiful holiday in privacy, away from the daily routine and their parents. After a journey full of adventures, aboard a sidecar , they find themselves in a campsite populated by Germans. They are attracted by the bewitching beauty of Valeria.

Title: 369. Jet Attack
description: Three American pilots are shot down behind enemy lines during the Korean war, where they encounter a mysterious Russian nurse. Their life is in her hands.

Title: 370. La chatte
description: In 1943, a French Resistance female fighter falls in love with the undercover German Intelligence agent sent to investigate her.

Title: 371. This Angry Age
description: During the 1950s, in French Indochina, the Dufresne family struggles to survive amid harsh economic times and natural disasters.

Title: 372. When Hell Broke Loose
description: In 1945, a GI falls in love with a German woman while elite German troops in U.S.uniforms carry out sabotage and assassinations behind American lines.

Title: 373. Lend Me Your Wife
description: The movie takes place in a company that sells baby toys. It is time to fill a leading position, and it is known the owner of the company only places married men on leading positions. This leads a young bachelor to "borrow" his best friends wife to have a chance at the position.

Title: 374. Adalat
description: Nirmala lives with her maternal uncle, his wife, and her widowed mom, studies in an Arts College, has a sweetheart in wealthy Rajinder R. Singh, who she plans to marry. Disagreements flare up at home when her aunt wants her to get married to an uneducated villager, Nirmala refuses to marry, instead gets a job at a Sada Bahar Nurtya Vidyalaya, which turns out to be a front for a brothel, landing her in prison. She gets off with a not guilty verdict, but is turned away from home, and the shock kills her mom. She attempts to find work, but is pursued relentlessly by a pimp, Pandit Kedarnath, who wants her for himself. Nirmala ends up as a Governess with none other than Rajinder's mom, where both lovers get married secretly. Rajinder then leaves for Britain, leaving behind a pregnant Nirmala. When the Singhs find out about her pregnancy and the man responsible, they refuse to believe her and throw her out straight into the arms of Kedarnath. She runs away and takes shelter working as a nurse in a private hospital where she gives birth to a baby boy. Kedarnanth once again shows up here, forcing the Trustees of the hospital to fire her. She flees with her child, and ends up at a brothel where she must accept this profession or see her child starve to death. She manages to smuggle the child to a kind-hearted doctor Renuka Roy. Years later, her son has grown up and is now the Public Prosecutor, and one of the first cases that he is to try is none other than that of Nirmala herself - a prostitute - who is now accused murder.

Title: 375. He Thief, She Thief
description: Cencio, a roman pilferer, periodically is in prison. He meets Cesira that soon become his partner in crime. With Cesira's help Cencio try the big hit to a jewelery. But the lucky break is over.

Title: 376. Vengeance
description: In rural Spain, sister of an ex con convinces him to take revenge against the local who tipped off the authorities about the man's whereabouts, which led to his subsequent arrest. Unfortunately, she soon falls in love with the snitch.

Title: 377. Someone Else's Children
description: Nato, a student, befriends two kids in the street, a brother and a sister. She doesn't know that their father has just broken off his girlfriend on the grounds that the latter couldn't find common language with the children.

Title: 378. March's Child
description: Francesca and Sandro meet, falls for each other and get married. But the differences between them are too many and the separation is around the corner.

Title: 379. El puño del amo
description:
From the legendary director, Emilio El Indio Fernandez, a powerful film of a woman fighting her rich established family to marry the man she loves. Starring Silvia Pinal, Amalia Mendoza and Carlos Lopez Moctezuma.

 Dirigida por el legendario Emilio El Indio Fernandez, esta historia esta basada en una novela donde una mujer confronta a su rica y establecida familia para casarse con el hombre a quien ella ama. Protagonizada por una contelacion de estrellas Mexicanas, Incluyendo: Silvia Pinal, Amalia Mendoza y Carlos Lopez Moctezuma.

Title: 380. Gunsmoke in Tucson
description: Two brothers on opposite sides of the law become involved in a range war between farmers and cattlemen in Arizona.

Title: 381. Tweet, Tweet
description: Young Tirlittan gets rid of her family after being struck by lightning in her home. While looking for a new home, she meets a friendly policeman, a woman with goat, and a ringmaster with whom Tirlittan ends up performing in a circus.

Title: 382. Once Upon a Horse...
description: Dan and Doc are incompetent desperados who plan to give crime one more try before going straight. Miss Amity Babb is the shapely toast of Empty Cup, Colorado who sets prices by Wall Street, never loses at poker, and rules the town (and the sheriff) with a cash register in a velvet glove. When Amity and our two heroes meet, the slapstick burlesque of Western cliches grows ever wilder...

Title: 383. Day of the Badman
description: Judge Jim Scott must contend with the vicious relatives of a murderer he's about to sentence - and his unfaithful fiancée.

Title: 384. The Husband
description: Alberto's marriage is a complete failure: his wife Elena is a hard woman influenced by her mother and sister who live with the married couple. Alberto is also experiencing financial problems and hopes for the help of a rich widow who is however interested in his sexual favours. Naturally Elena puts obstacles in his way and everything goes wrong. Alberto decides to change job then and becomes a sweets sales representative. Disillusioned with marital life he also changes his attitude towards women: he tells every woman he meets he is single.

Title: 385. Missiles from Hell
description: A group of fighters of the Polish resistance movement go on a mission to destroy the German V-1 'Flying Bomb' at Peenemünde and cripple the German war effort during World War II.

Title: 386. Thundering Jets
description: Captain Steve Morley (Rex Reason) must evaluate how the men under his command react to pressure and stress at high altitudes in the latest jet fighters, with the usual romantic subplot involving him, another officer, and a pretty young lady. Exciting flight sequences, filmed at Edwards (Muroc) Air Force Base, California, showcases Reason and other pilots going off into the wild blue (black and white) yonder, in widescreen Regalscope (CinemaScope).

Title: 387. Invisible Avenger
description: Lamont Cranston, aka The Shadow, investigates the murder of a New Orleans bandleader.

Title: 389. Wolf Larsen
description: A crazed, tyrannical--but cultured--sea captain holds a ship's crew and passengers in an iron grip. During a titanic storm, the passengers finally manage to break free.

Title: 390. Wet Asphalt
description: In Berlin, when the journalist Greg Bachmann is released from prison six months before the end of his sentence, there is a driver named Jupp waiting for him.

Title: 391. The Flower in Hell
description: A country bumpkin (Dong-shik) goes to Seoul in order to bring his older brother (Young-shik)back to the country. Little does he know Young-shik is a petty crook involved with a prostitute (Sonia) who is servicing American GIs. Then Sonia comes onto Dong-shik...

Title: 392. The Solitary Child
description: A young woman's marriage to a gentleman farmer, acquitted of murdering his first wife, nearly leads to her own untimely end.

Title: 393. Bachelor of Hearts
description: German scholar Wolf Hauser arrives for a year at Cambridge. Apart from his studies, he tries to muck in with the very English non-academic goings-on while romancing pretty Girton girl Ann.

Title: 394. The Day of the Trumpet
description: An American cavalry brigade is sent to occupy a small Filipino village in 1902 and quell guerilla resistance in the surrounding jungle. Working with the people to build roads, schools, and bridges, they prove that the most important thing an army can have is "good will and integrity."

Title: 395. Cette nuit là...
description: Jean, who is the artistic director of a fashion magazine, is married to a very pretty cover girl, Sylvie. They both work for André Reverdy, a very cynical man, who openly covets Sylvie. Jean, awfully jealous, can't put up with the situation. Persuaded that his young wife has given herself to his rival he goes and waits for Reverdy outside his bachelor flat. When the hated man goes out, he kills him...

Title: 396. The Phantom Carriage
description: The third film adaptation of Selma Lagerlöf's novel. The drinker David Holm gets killed right on the stroke of midnight on New Year's Eve. He will now face the death coachman, which happens to be his old friend.

Title: 397. Szent Péter esernyöje
description: A comedy about a lost inheritance, love and a red umbrella, which, according to a local legend, belonged to St. Peter himself.

Title: 398. Fast and Sexy
description: A beautiful, wealthy widow leaves New York to find herself a husband in the Italian village in which she was born. After many tries she...chooses the village blacksmith.

Title: 399. Anak Pontianak
description: A woman named Manis screams in pain one night while giving birth to her twins. Sensing her imminent death, she instructs her husband to do one last thing, to pull out a nail that has been stuck at the back of her neck for years. This sets off a terrifying transformation, before she dies. A year later, she returns from the dead, to his horror, and swears to protect her son Petir forever. Petir grows up to be strong with an occasional display of an aggressive behaviour. Ten years later, he falls in love with Halimah, a beautiful village girl, much to the dismay of an elderly scientist, Dr Sulong who has the same feelings for her. When the village is plagued by evil forces, Petir finds himself changing into a horrible creature, to protect the love of his life.

Title: 400. Girls at Sea
description: When H.M.S. Scotia pays a visit to the French Riviera, the officers throw a party to celebrate the engagement of Marine Captain Robert "Bobby" Randall to Jill Eaton.

Title: 401. Prescription for Murder
description: American doctor Jethro Jones comes to a quiet English seaside resort to investigate the activities of its leading medical doctor, Henry Dysert. He learns from Miss Bettyhill, the town gossip, and others that 'the good doctor' might not be all that good, since each of his three former wives - Louise, Charlotte and Stella - had mysterious and tragic deaths. The other townspeople had regarded the three deaths, each of which left Doctor Dysert in better financial shape, as unfortunate personal tragedies. Jason has only a short time to prove that Dysert was a multiple wife-killer, since Kitty Mortlock appears to be the next designated victim, and Jason has fallen in love with her.

Title: 402. Mad Little Island
description: Inhabitants of the Hebridean isle of Todday resist the British government's plan to turn their island home into a missile base.

Title: 403. The Son of Robin Hood
description: The son of Robin Hood dons his father's famous tights. Unfortunately, he's nowhere near as good as his father was, and so the Merry Men look for Robin's other child.

Title: 404. Escuela de rateros
description: The police plan to capture a killer by using a double that looks exactly as one of his victims.

Title: 405. The Moonraker
description: After the battle of Worcester at the end of the Civil War, the main aim of Oliver Cromwell's Commonwealth is to capture Charles Stuart. The future king's escape depends on the intrepid Earl of Dawlish.

Title: 406. Step Down to Terror
description: A killer on the lam takes refuge in his childhood home where his mother and widowed sister-in-law are ignorant of his criminal past.

Title: 407. Skinny and Fatty
description: Two young Japanese schoolboys, one skinny and poor, one fat and well-to-do, become unlikely friends.

Title: 408. Timbuktu
description: In 1940, in the colony of French Sudan, a Tuareg uprising is being instigated by an evil emir but the French Army, aided by an American gun-runner, intends to pacify the region.

Title: 409. Pathetic Fallacy
description: Bimal is a taxi-driver in a small town. His taxi is his only companion and, although very battered, it is the apple of Bimal's eye. The film shows the love of taxi driver Bimal and his pathetic vehicle Jagaddal.

Title: 410. This Happy Feeling
description: On a stormy night, young woman asks another guest at party to rescue her from her lecherous boss and take her to the train station. After her rescuer suggests that she stop at his place to get out of her wet clothes, she dashes from his car. The door she knocks on for help is the home of a retired actor and there she spends the rest of the night. He makes no passes and next morning she discovers the young man who drove her from party is his next door neighbor. The two men compete for her affections. Older man's zany live-in housekeeper and a seagull she has rescued provide comic relief.

Title: 411. One Life
description: Normandy, second half of the nineteenth century. Jeanne Dandieu lives in a manor house with her parents and their servant Rosalie. She gets to know Julien, a handsome man, whom she soon marries. Her happiness is short-lived as she finds out that not only has Julien married her for her money but he cheats on her as well - with Rosalie to crown it all. The latter gives birth to a baby girl before leaving the house. Six years later, Julien has a new mistress, Gilberte de Fourcheville. Jeanne puts up with this new ordeal bravely. However, Gilberte's husband surprises the two lovers in a caravan and, in a rage, hurls them over the edge of a cliff.

Title: 412. Love on the Riviera
description: It is Summer. It is the right time for love, especially in a most romantic place as Golfo del Tigullio. Different stories: Dorina looking for a rich lover; Clara who takes a fancy to the young Walter while her daughter Lina tries to save her; Aristarco who gave up his career to follow Ada's, but who likes Jacqueline; Renata who is offered by her husband to Ferrari to get money; Marcello who, extraditing Micheline to France, misses the train and falls in love with her.

Title: 413. The Year Long Road
description: The plot is set in an underdeveloped and remote area of a fictitious country, where the locals try to build an asphalt road in spite of careless attitude of the Government. The story follows the adventures in their self-reliant mission that lasts a whole year.

Title: 414. Chain of Events
description: A bank clerk dodges his bus fare. But this small act soon ripples through many lives - at times with catastrophic consequences.

Title: 415. Tarawa Beachhead
description: A Marine sergeant falls in love with the widow of a comrade shot in combat by their lieutenant.

Title: 416. Floods of Fear
description: Two inmates working to shore up a dike during a severe flood are swept away in the current along with their guard. The three of them wind up in an isolated house whose flooded interior contains a frightened woman.

Title: 417. Sea Fury
description: Off the Spanish coast, two tug-boat captains are caught in a violent feud over a woman but their rivalry is set aside when a sinking freighter carrying explosives must be salvaged and towed to port.

Title: 418. Our Virgin Island
description: Two newlyweds buy a small private island in the British Virgin Islands and live a happy life without the comforts of modern society.

Title: 419. Johnny Rocco
description: Gangster and police look for a gangster's son who witnessed a murder.

Title: 420. La passe du diable
description: Rahim's older brother Mokhi refuses to take him to Kabul's big bouzkachi game. Rahim decides to go there on his own. Guided by the angel of death, Azrael, Rahim follows a difficult path to Kabul.

Title: 421. Djamilah
description: The story of Algerian freedom fighter Djamila Bouhired who played a key role in resisting French colonial rule and the fight for Algeria's independence.

Title: 422. Khalid ibn el Walid
description: The story of Khalid Ibn Al-Walid (592-642) the greatest military leader in the dawn of Islam during the life of prophet Muhammad and his caliphs Abu Bakr and Omar.

Title: 423. South Seas Adventure
description: The fifth in a series of Cinerama travelogues---and not a Documentary since the vast majority of the film, aside from the scenery, is comprised of fictional stories. The first one involves an American girl, on a cruise to Hawaii, who makes friends with another American girl who lives in Hawaii. The first girl meets the second girl's family, and the Hawaiian-girl's brother takes an interest in her. The second segment follows the skipper of a sailing vessel taking the route followed by Captain Cook; the next concerns an artist who paints the sights of Tahiti; An American ex-G.I, stationed in New Zealand during World Warr II, returns for a real visit; and the finale is about a group of settlers arriving in the Australian out-back, and the value of the two-way radio.The 120-minute running time includes a 15-minute intermission, as part of the listed running-time.

Title: 424. Sinners of Paris
description: Le Fondu, a famous gangster, escapes from the hospital where he was detained, killing an inspector in the process. The colleague of the deceased inspector, Paul Vardier, vows to avenge him. The task seems hopeless; Le Fondu has disappeared without a trace and nobody has a clue about his hide-out. There is only one faint possibility left - coerce Le Fondu's nephew into becoming an informer. Paul gets assigned as buddy Gilbert Barot, fresh from the police academy, and whose alluring wife Lucie quickly arouses the interest of Paul. He is quickly led to play two dangerous games simultaneously - seducing the wife of his colleague, and tracking with him Le Fondu, who himself does not remain inactive.

Title: 425. Man or Gun
description: A gun-slinging drifter, armed with a legendary pistol, saves a town from the greedy clutches of an evil family. But what makes him so fast? Is it the man or the gun?

Title: 426. The Gypsy and the Gentleman
description: Belle (Melina Mercouri) is a tempestuous Gypsy girl who is after Sir Paul Deverill (Keith Michell). Her plan is to marry him and take him for every penny he has before moving on to other lovers.

Title: 427. We Only Live Once
description: A bank teller discovers an accounting error and becomes rich.

Title: 428. A Question of Infidelity
description: Mark Loring is madly jealous of his wife, Mary, former American cabaret singer. Due to an automobile accident, she loses her unborn child, and Mark becomes sterile. His father, the stuffy Sir John Loring, has never approved of the marriage and, again, tries to break it up. Believing that a child will hold the marriage together, Mary suggests artificial insemination to Mark, who finally agrees to accompany her to a clinic in Switzerland. However, when she is again pregnant, Mark finds it impossible to reconcile himself to the situation and leaves her. Prompted by his father, Mark sues for divorce, accusing her of adultery. She contests the divorce and a trial concerns itself with whether or not artificial insemination is a question of adultery. (The Catholic Church's National League of Decency placed this film on its "Condemned" list).

Title: 429. High Hell
description: A greedy miner's determination to continue winter blasting in the Canadian Rockies threatens to bring avalanches down on a small village.

Title: 430. Dva Fyodora
description: At the end of the Second World War, Fedor is demobilized and returns home where he meets a homeless boy, small Fedor.

Title: 431. The Littlest Hobo
description: A German Shepherd dog helps a lamb to escape the slaughter house.

Title: 432. The Man on the Train
description: A stop at a level crossing brings a happily married woman face-to-face with the memory of a fleeting liaison with a Resistance fighter. Now, this bittersweet fantasy demands answers. Has a ghost from the distant past returned to haunt her?

Title: 433. A Bullet in the Gun Barrel
description: Back from Indochina, Tony and Dick, two French soldiers, are now in possession of more than 20 million, entrusted by a trafficker. They buy a nightclub in Montparnasse but are soon hunted by the thug who wants to recover his money.

Title: 434. Goha
description: In Egypt, an old man decides to marry a beautiful young woman, who happens to be in love with another poor young man.

Title: 435. La spada e la croce
description: Set against the magnificent backdrop of classic Rome, "The Sword and the Cross" is the story of a notorious harlot who must choose between her lascivious lifestyle and the love and affection of her decent-minded brother.

Title: 436. Trip to the Moon
description: Two friends try to hide and end up in an insane asylum, where they are mistaken for patients, and when they try to escape one of them falls in love and complicates the situation.

Title: 437. Die grünen Teufel von Monte Cassino
description: In 1944, German paratroopers must defend the Monte Cassino area of Italy from Allied attacks while artifacts from the nearby historical abbey are evacuated to the Vatican by army trucks.

Title: 438. Post Box 999
description: Mohan is a young man who lives with his widowed mother, is in love with a young woman named Shyama, and both would like to get married. Unfortunately, before that could happen, Shyama is shot dead, the police get involved, an eye-witness named Bindiya names Mohan as the killer, as such Mohan is arrested, tried in Court, found guilty and sentenced to be hanged. The only one who believes in Mohan's innocence is his mother, Gangadevi. She advertises in the newspapers offering a reward of Rs.10,000/- to whoever can prove her son innocent, asking readers to direct their responses to Post Box 999. No one ever responds, until after 5 years when a Reporter, Vikas, of "Prakash" publications comes across the ad and decides to prove Mohan innocent. Assisting him are Gangadevi and a young woman named Nilima, eventually both Nilima and Vikas fall in love. Their investigation take them to a variety of people, including Banarsilal, Bindiya who witnessed the killing, and a killer named Shamsher Singh, who abducts Nilima. Now Vikas has only one day to prove Mohan's innocence, and he must use it to either do that or save Nilima from Shamsher's clutches.

Title: 439. Ama a tu prójimo
description: A series of vignettes about the cases attended by the doctors and nurses at the Mexico City Red Cross hospital.

Title: 440. Pepeng Kaliwete
description: With hate locked deep in his heart and fear in his holster he walked on to keep a rendezvous with danger and death.

Title: 441. Hong Kong Confidential
description: During the Cold War, an American secret agent must find a kidnapped Arab prince who is being used by the Soviets to gain leverage against America's plans to install missiles in a Middle-Eastern country.

Title: 442. Indrani
description: Unemployed and lower-caste Sudarshan marries Indrani, a successful Brahmin woman. But their marriage faces society's prejudice as clashes between Sudarshan's manhood and Indrani's self-respect put their relationship to the test.

Title: 443. The Naked Earth
description: In 1890s East Africa, an Irishman arrives expecting a thriving farm, only to discover his partner is dead. He marries his friend's widow and battles failed crops, native unrest, and perilous crocodile hunts to survive the wild wilderness.

Title: 444. Domenica è sempre domenica
description: A television broadcast launches a proclamation for amateurs: "If you know how to speak, you will know how to sing". The award mirage lured many person, with ambitions or financial problems, to enroll in the competition.

Title: 445. Yagyû bugeichô: Sôryû hiken
description: In the Tokugawa Era, the clan of Lord Yagyu has hidden away three scrolls containing clan secrets which, if revealed, would cause revolution and disaster for the clan. The information is divided among the three scrolls, all of which must be possessed for the secrets to be understood. When Princess Yuhime steals the scrolls, Tasaburo, a samurai with magical powers, and his brother Senshiro are sent to retrieve them. In Part II, the search for the scrolls continues.

Title: 446. I Dutifully Report
description: Sequel of the adaptation of the famous satiric tale of well-intending soldier Schweik by Jaroslav Hasek.

Title: 447. I Only Arsked!
description: Disgruntled soldiers posted to British-ruled Darawa unexpectedly find a secret entrance to the King's harem, complicating their mission.

Title: 448. The Flame Barrier
description: Carol Dahlmann asks the Hollister brothers to find her missing husband, who was tracking a satellite in the jungle. Searching for him, they find a powerful acid killing animals and people.

Title: 449. Harry Black and the Tiger
description: During a hunt for a ferocious tiger terrorizing an Indian village, ex-army Colonel Harry Black comes across the wife of his former army buddy and co-POW Desmond Tanner..

Title: 450. Rooney
description: The life of James Ignatius Rooney, a Dublin rubbish collector during the week and a Gaelic sportsman at the weekends.

Title: 451. Money, Women and Guns
description: After a gold prospector is killed by masked robbers, a detective is hired to find the surviving killer as well as the prospector's legal inheritors.

Title: 452. Red Pier
description: 50s subculture icon Yujiro Ishihara (Crazed Fruit) stars in Masuda's Red Pier as "Jiro the Lefty", a killer with a natural talent. Shortly after arriving in Kobe, he witnesses a man die in a crane accident which turns out to be a cover-up for a murder. Jiro soon finds himself on the run, tailed by a determined cop...

Title: 453. The Desperate Men
description: A GI deserter frames a girl for killing a blackmailer and holds her captive while seeking gems.

Title: 454. Girl and the River
description: Old Félix, a prosperous land owner in Haute Provence, will be expropriated because a dam is being built on the River Durance and his estate is to be flooded. He receives thirty million francs in compensation but dies soon after. Hortense, his only daughter, inherits the money but the trouble is that Félix has hidden the loot somewhere and it is nowhere to be found. All of Hortense's next of kin suddenly take an interest in the "poor orphan" and those greedy ones - with the exception of kind-hearted uncle Simon - put pressure on the girl, and try - through wile, threat and even murder, to inveigle her inheritance. But however young and frail Hortense is, she is nobody's fool.

Title: 455. Flottans överman
description: Fabian Bom has been sent by the Export Association to promote the Swedish export to Spain. He travels with the navy's cruiser to Barcelona, but his jealous fiancée Gullan has followed him in secrecy to keep an eye on him. In Barcelona the usually strict and virtuous Bom is surrounded by the local women and has a ball. He meets the young and zestful Linnea from Sweden.

Title: 456. Secrets of a French Nurse
description: A gangster is back in business after a while and tries to take it back. In the hard way. But every thing goes wrong for him. In the same time, we watch the fate of a young nurse in a hospital. Soon, the two stories meet when the gangster faces his problems.

Title: 457. Mogli pericolose
description: Federico, Bruno, Pirro and Benny are married. The first three have beautiful wifes, Benny instead is married to a ugly woman. Ornella is Bruno's wife, she is very jealous and maintains that all men are deceitful, granted the opportunity, while Claudine, Federico's wife, maintains the contrary point of view. So they bet that Tosca, a former dancer, will succeed in seducing Federico. Troubles for everyone.

Title: 458. High School Hellcats
description: A good girl is forced to join a dangerous all-girl high school gang, and only her waiter boyfriend and a caring female teacher can possibly help her before it may become too late.

Title: 459. A Lust to Kill
description: A cowboy escapes from jail with the help of his girlfriend, and goes after the men he believes are responsible for his brother being shot down by lawmen.

Title: 460. Das Lied der Matrosen
description: The Russian Revolution is finally triumphant in the Fall of 1917. As soldiers, the engineer Henne Lobke and the stoker Jens Kasten show solidarity with the Russians, eventually disarming their officers to stop the sinking of a Russian cargo ship. Back in Germany, the struggle continues. The dock-workers and sailors of Kiel call for a mass strike to demand the end of the war and the abdication of the Kaiser and his officers. At this point, the admiralty decides to launch the operation 'Nibelungen.' The entire German fleet is to be sent to battle the English in a suicide mission that would preserve German honor while crushing internal mutiny. The workers in uniform put aside their differences to stop this, however, as is the case with chief stoker August Lenz, the radio officer Ludwig Bartuscheck and the assistant to the vice-admiral Jupp Koenig. The film ends with the founding of the Communist Party of Germany (KPD).

Title: 461. A Nice Little Bank That Should Be Robbed
description: Three horse-racing lovers turn to robbery to appease their gambling appetites. Max is the nice, easygoing, vitamin-gulping guy with an out-sized swallow tube; Gus is his penniless, parasitic friend and Rocky is their bookie pal. Gus persuades Max that with his unusual swallow tube they could rob a bank and Max could swallow the note to be shown the teller after the money is handed over. They pull off the robbery with incredible ease, become involved with a vitamin-gulping horse, lose their bank roll, try robbery again - and wind up behind the Eight Ball.

Title: 462. Ghost of the China Sea
description: A ragtag band of civilians and military personnel evade the Japanese in the Philippines, utilising the so-called USS Frankenstein.

Title: 463. Let's Rock
description: Singer's girlfriend helps him adjust to the new rock'n'roll music.

Title: 464. Edge of Fury
description: A psychopathic young beachcomber pretends to befriend a mother and two daughters living at their summer home.

Title: 466. Zhenikh s togo sveta
description: Petukhov S.D., one of local authorities, gets into tickler upon arriving from 3 days trip.

Title: 467. Sahara
description: Orphaned Leela lives with her cruel aunt, Rangilibai; cousin, Kaushalya; and uncle. When Rangilibai arranges Kaushalya's marriage to a wealthy landlord, Leela agrees to go with her as a maid as part of her dowry. But things change for the better for Leela, when the landlord rejects Kaushalya and decides to get married to Leela. As a result Leela gets married and moves into the landlord's house. Then things take a turn for the worse, when Leela is accused of having a lover, and is asked to leave. She goes to Rangilibai's house, but is shunned and kicked out. Alone, helpless, she comes upon a distant relative named Gaman Singh, who takes her in to live with him and his wife, Swarupbai. When Leela is asked to beg for alms, she refuses, and Swarupbai blinds her with special eye-drops. Then a blinded Leela is led through the streets and made to sit daily near the steps of a temple singing and begging for alms. It looks like fate has chosen this profession for Leela, and there appears to be no way out of this vicious circle for a blind young woman, who has been shunned by her husband and relatives.

Title: 468. Fridolf sticker opp!
description: Fridolf is responsible at the office while his boss is away on business.

Title: 470. Duel in the Forest
description: The movie reports the historical story of Schinderhannes, based on a play by Carl Zuckmayr. Johannes Bückler, this his real name, led a band of brigands in the Hunsrück mountains during Napoleonic times.

Title: 471. Stakeout on Dope Street
description: This crime drama follows three teenagers who find a fortune in pure heroin lost by a gang of dope peddlers during a gun battle with the police.

Title: 472. Totò a Parigi
description: Duclos's son, a worldly gangster, is compromised in a case of which he is innocent. The proof of this innocence is in the hands of a "competitor", the Marquis de Chemantel de Beauvoiron, a misguided aristocrat. He asks for $10 million to cede the document. Duclos then imagines Chemantel contracting $10 million in life insurance for his son. In Rome he discovers a tramp who looks just like the Marquis, so he brings the man to Paris and arrange his accidental.

Title: 473. Un drôle de dimanche
description: Jean Brevent has never been able to work out why his wife Catherine walked out on him. Five years later, he meets her by chance on a bus, but they are soon separated again.

Title: 474. Village by the River
description: An independent-thinking doctor in a rural community with his own ideas of how medicine should be practiced begins to find himself ostracized from the community after one of his patients commits suicide.

Title: 475. El fotogénico
description: A small-town telegrapher signs up for a singing contest in the hopes of meeting a singing star he is in love with.

Title: 476. Locura musical
description: Esta pelÍcula tuvo casos extremos de distorsión / recorte y silbido / ruido a través de. se logró la máxima calidad posible para el audio restaurado basado en la condición de la fuente de audio original.

Title: 477. El tigre de Chamberí
description: Miguel becomes a boxing champion by chance and, motivated by love, he will deliver the final blow.

Title: 478. El inquilino
description: A physician assistant and his wife search for an apartment in 1958 Spain while raising four kids in a condemned building, facing challenges and funny situations along the way.

Title: 479. The Shop Curtain
description: The story of generations of kelp merchants in Osaka.

Title: 481. Benten kozô
description: As the honorable thief who doubles as a courtly woman, Raizo Ichikawa gives a brashly modern gender-bending performance in this classic kabuki spin on the Robin Hood legend.

Title: 482. Na malkiya ostrov
description: The film is a bitter parable about the slow maturing of the idea of freedom - both collective and personal. The characters's deaths are absurd, with no pathos.

Title: 483. Las chicas de la Cruz Roja
description: Four girls meet in Madrid while asking for donations for the Red Cross.

Title: 484. Nichiren to moko daishurai
description: Legendary Buddhist monk Nichiren (Kazuo Hasegawa) returns from his studies to lead Japan out of moral crisis and prepare to fight the Mongol invaders during the 1200's by creating a new form of Buddhism. He runs afoul of the existing Buddhist sects and their government supporters and is persecuted. Can Nichiren persevere before the Mongol fleet reaches Japanese shores?

Title: 485. Prisons de femmes
description: Alice Rémon, a pharmacist, is a prostitute who managed to leave the streets by getting married. Her husband dies one day, poisoned. Her mother-in-law, who hates her, accuses her of murder.

Title: 486. Mr. Q
description: Mr Q is about a teacher named Mr. Q coming up to America to teach Spanish. He has a hard time doing this when he has to deal with disobedient students at a ghetto C. Milton Wright HS in Bel Air Maryland

Title: 487. Badman's Country
description: Showdown in Abilene between lawmen Pat Garrett, Wyatt Earp, Bat Masterson and Butch Cassidy's gang over a large shipment of money arriving by train.

Title: 488. Arms and the Man
description: In 1865, Swiss captain Bluntschli fights as a mercenary in the war between Bulgaria and Serbia. When his group is attacked by a few Bulgarian troopers, he learns that he's got the wrong ammunition for his cannon and should flee. His flight leads him right into the bedroom of his enemy's fiancée.

Title: 489. Styrmand Karlsen
description: First mate Knud Karlsen has just received sad news from his girlfriend. On board the ship is also chef Valdemar, sailor Ole, owner's confident son Robert and a whole bunch of eager sailors. On board develops the drama out every minute, culminating in the film's climax, when a fire breaks out on board

Title: 490. Underwater Warrior
description: Based upon the life of Commander Francis D. Fane (USNR), "Underwater Warrior" follows the evolution of the US Navy's Underwater Demolition Unit from its inception near the end of World War II through its acceptance and finally successful utilization in Korea. Landmark underwater camera work makes this film a milestone in cinematic history.

Title: 491. Revolt in the Big House
description: Gannon is an imprisoned racketeer kingpin who tries to manipulate his young cell mate into staging a riot and prison break, but the cell mate tries to back out when he realizes other inmates may be killed in the process.

Title: 492. Girl on the Run
description: A private investigator is hired to find and protect a singer who witnessed the murder of a union official and is being stalked by the killer. What he doesn't know is that he has been hired by the killer himself.

Title: 493. Island Women
description: The semi-steamy story (more in promise than actual deliverance) is set in Nassau and finds Mike, an American charter boat captain, involved in a romance with tourist Jan but Jan's aunt, Elizabeth also has the hots for Mike and tries to break up the romance. She hides her bracelet in a straw bag belonging to Mike's mate, Eban, and then claims it was stolen. She then agrees to drop the theft charges if Mike will ditch Jan and go off with her. What's a poor guy to do? Well, mostly hang around and listen to Leslie Scott, Kay Barnes, Irene Williams and other Calypso performers sing "Cocoanut, Water, Rum and Gin", "Wanna Do Nothin' All Day" and "Island WOMEN" and watch "The Limbo" being danced.

Title: 494. El hombre que logró ser invisible
description: Framed for murder, Carlos escapes prison with the help of an invisibility serum developed by his brother. He races against the clock to prove his innocence before the drug drives him insane.

Title: 495. Eine Frau, die weiss, was sie will
496. Ház a sziklák alatt
description: A returned prisoner of war, his pretty new wife and his first wife's hunchbacked sister live together in a small isolated house, but none of them can find happiness.

Title: 497. Little Peach
description: Kyoko, the daughter of a successful novelist, marries an aspiring writer. However, her husband's difficulties with his writing and his resentment over her father cause deep strains in the marriage.

Title: 498. El secuestrador
description: A group of poor people living on the bare minimum in a slum, trying to survive in a world that seems to have no place for them. With a tone raw and realistic story portrays their daily tragedies, and their struggle to survive.

Title: 499. Orang Minyak
description: A village comes alive with fear when a nefarious 'oily man' terrorises women in the dead of night. At their wits end, the local police enlist the help of talented police inspector Dasuki to trap and end the oily man's mischief.

Title: 500. The Nuremberg Trials
description: Documentary with recordings from the Nuremberg war crimes trials.

Title: 501. The Adventures of Hal 5
description: A children's adventure. Hal V is a car owned (and loved) by the Hayward family and their children. Then a wicked garage owner tries to steal their beloved car to sell for lots of money, but the children are too quick for him and foil his wicked plots at every turn.

Title: 502. Port of Desire
description: A French sailor, returning to Hamburg where he had been imprisoned during WWII, looks for a German woman he had loved in those days, and finds her in a night club.

Title: 503. The Boy Who Came Back
description: Nobuo is a hot-headed hoodlum fresh out of reform school who struggles to make a clean break with his tearaway past.

Title: 504. A Cry from the Streets
description: A welfare worker becomes emotionally involved with her charges, a group of adorable, homeless orphans.

Title: 505. Jomalaye Jibanta Manush
description: When the messengers of 'Yamraj'- God of Death - mistakenly bring an alive, honest person to hell, he starts a revolution to fix outdated rules of heaven and hell.

Title: 507. The Warrior and the Slave Girl
description: Marco Numidio (Ettore Manni), a Roman tribune sent to Armenia to put down a gladiators' revolt, captures the rebels' popular leader, Asclepio (Georges Marchal). Princess Amira (Gianna Maria Canale), with ambitions of being queen and jealous of Asclepio's popularity, plans his death in the arena by substituting a lion for his human opponent.

Title: 508. Maratón de baile
description: In this musical comedy-drama from Cuban-born actor/director Rene Cardona, several couples are lured into becoming contestants in a dance marathon that awards a large cash prize to the last couple standing at the end of this grueling endurance test. They all hope to win, for different reasons: a bank employee and his wife has a sick child in need of the best care money can buy; a young couple hopes to use the money to start out in life together; a taxi-dancer and her man hope to leave their old lives behind once and for all. This film features an attractive cast and lively musical numbers, including a full mariachi band.

Title: 510. Hello London
description: Norwegian figure skater and film star Sonja Henie is showcased in this CinemaScope pseudo-documentary.

Title: 511. Spy in the Sky!
description: A captured German engaged in the Russian satellite program, holds the secret of Sputnik's beep signals. He escapes into the Free World where he is kidnapped by agents who want to sell him to the highest bidder.

Title: 512. Life Begins at 17
description: A rich college fraternity man tries to get a small-town beauty-contest winner to fall for him by making a play for her 16-year-old sister.

Title: 513. 3 straniere a Roma
description: Three girls from Milan dreaming of a holiday in Rome arrive in the city by train and decide to pretend to be rich Danish girls to attract three nice guys... Three guys looking for easy-going girls offer them a guided tour through the most beautiful places of the city. The girls accept and make the guys spend a fortune, but one evening they get drunk and one of them incidentally reveals she's just from Milan. The guys get upset and set up a sort of revenge, but in the end they make it up. One of the very first movies with Claudia Cardinale in a leading role.

Title: 514. Embezzled Heaven
description: This is a story of human struggle for eternal happiness. Teta Linek, a cook at a noble Austrian family Argan, thinks primarily of ways to achieve heavens in the afterlife. In the hope of merciful acts, she helps her nephew, Mojmir, become a priest and sends him a lot of money for years. The problem is, however, that she does not meet him for a long time. But once, when he writes to her about his graduation in seminar, Teta, in her naiveness, travels to Hustopec to help him on his first parish. There, the truth is revealed - Mojmir is not a priest, lives in Prague, and spends the money on something entirely different. Teta starts to blame herself for naiveness and selfishness in heading for her personal happiness. In her despair, she pilgrims to Rome where she hopes to get a redeeming blessing from the Pope. To her relief, the whole group takes part in the audience at Pius XII. Soon after, Teta falls ill and having been rewarded by the Holy Father, she dies full of hope to get a beautiful place in heaven.

Title: 517. The Adventures of Remi
description: An orphan ,Remi ,was sold to an itinerant musician ,Vitalis ,who travels with his performing animals.

Title: 518. Weddings and Babies
description: Photographer struggles to make enough money to marry his fiancee, who is starting to believe he's delaying their marriage deliberately.

Title: 519. Le septième ciel
description: Scoundrels must go to heaven, and the only way for them to redeem their souls is to die after "donating" their money to those in strained circumstances.

Title: 520. D-ale carnavalului
description: Nae Girimea, a hairdresser from a Bucharest brick of the late nineteenth century, finds a new mistress in the person of Didina. This will obscure the mad jealousy of her soul-mistress, Mita Baston, and the violent Pampon, Didina's official lover.

Title: 521. Bustenskjold
description: Jens von Bustenskjold is a farmer despite his more promising family past when his family was of a fine descent. But he is lazy, and he wants to improve by marrying rich. Then he inherits a large sum of money.

Title: 522. Next to No Time!
description: An unassuming planning engineer must negotiate an important loan while aboard the Queen Elizabeth en route to New York City, but his lack of confidence threatens to foil his plans.

Title: 523. The Narcotics Story
description: Semi-documentary on how marijuana dealers lure small-town teenagers into heroin use and prostitution and how the police help to fight it.

Title: 524. Young Breasts
description: Young hoodlum tries to go straight after falling in love with his social worker.

Title: 525. Female Fiends
description: A man, awakening with no memory, is told he is an heir to millions, but he suspects he is an heir to trouble instead.

Title: 526. Amar Deep
description: Aruna lives a wealthy lifestyle with her paternal grandfather. She has come of marriageable age and he wants her to get married to a young man named Pran. But Aruna finds him possessive, controlling, and hot-tempered, and will not have anything to do with him, so she decides to run away. Her grandfather asks Pran to search everywhere for her, and Pran takes a oath that he will not return home until he finds her. He does find her and brings her back home. Shortly thereafter, her grandpa develops complications and passes away, leaving her in the care of Pran and a servant named Harriya. When Pran offers to marry her, she refuses and tells him that she loves another man, Ashok, she met when she ran away, the one who lives in an abandoned bus in the country. When they locate Ashok, he is unable to recognize her, and is in the company of a beautiful street dancer, Roopa, who he hopes to get married to soon. Was her romance with Ashok all a dream for Aruna, or is there some other reason why Ashok is refusing to recognize her?

Title: 527. Nishi Ginza Station
description: While his wife and children are away on holiday, a henpecked, daydreaming pharmacist begins a flirtatious relationship with the pretty girl in the boutique opposite. Almost a Japanese screwball comedy.

Title: 528. Lone Texan
description: After the Civil War, a Texan who served in the Union army comes back home to find himself ostracized by his neighbors for having fought against the Confederacy. On top of that, he finds that his younger brother is now the sheriff, and is ruling the town with an iron hand.

Title: 529. Scampolo
description: A naive, poor girl falls for an architect on the beautiful island of Ischia.

Title: 531. Night Drum
description: When a married woman has an affair with a young musician, feudal Japanese law requires that both offenders pay with their lives. However, the woman's husband blames himself for his wife's straying and attempts to thwart the law demanding capital punishment.

Title: 532. Aren't We Wonderful?
description: The movie explains Germany from 1913 until 1955 by example of two contrary characters: The idealistic journalist Hans (H.-J. Felmy) loses his work during the Third Reich, whereas opportunist Bruno (R. Graf) makes career to himself in the NSDAP party. After World War II ended, Bruno manages to be indispensable to the US administration and becomes a successful and well respected businessman, despite his Nazi-past. At the same time, Hans tries to earn a living on the countryside. But one day a time will come when both men will meet again.

Title: 533. Kommunist
description: A devoted struggle for better life.

Title: 534. Der Arzt von Stalingrad
description: After the battle of Stalingrad, battalions of German prisoners were taken to concentration camps. To the 5110/47 comes the military medical Fritz Böhler. He tries to improve the prisoners' conditions, sometimes risking his life.

Title: 535. Dilli Ka Thug
description: A thug from Delhi is accused of killing a young boy in Bombay.

Title: 536. La sonrisa de la Virgen
description: Marita, a charming little girl, lives in the country with his grandmother. Her best friend is a modest servant, Anselmo, who almost everyday takes the girl to visit the church known as "Guadalupe's Basilica", an important temple in Mexico City, where she discovers Virgin Guadalupe and the legend about her apparitions in that place. Marita doesn't behave properly in school, and her teacher always has a punishment for the girl. She doesn't like school, and she doesn't want to return to school anymore. Besides, Marita's worry about her animals, like a cow, who doesn't produce milk. The girl asks many miracles to Virgin Guadalupe, one of them is not going to school. During a visit to Basilica, Marita hears the Virgin's voice, and this could be the beginning of a responsible life for the girl, like to study and to be a good child.

Title: 537. La cama de piedra
description: Antonio is happy and is about to get married, but he has an enemy who wants to kill him. He steals his knife known by the whole town and kills a drunkard with it. With this evidence Antonio is sentenced to fifteen years in prison.

Title: 538. Bari Theke Paliye
description: A misbehaving boy who runs away from his village and goes to Calcutta.

Title: 539. Immer die Radfahrer
description: Three old friends are going on a cycle holiday, like they did 20 years ago.

Title: 540. The Island of Silence
description: Just off the East Coast of Crete lies the isolated islet of Spinalonga. From 1903 to 1958, this desolate land served as a last refuge for those living with Hansen's disease. Can two idealists make a difference in a place steeped in sorrow?

Title: 541. El puente de la paz
description: Two villages plan to build a bridge between them as a good will symbol, but none of the majors has asked the man whose land is needed.

Title: 542. The High Cost of Loving
description: When he's not invited to a boardroom luncheon with the company president and his executives, during the company's merger and downsizing phase, purchasing manager Jim Fry fears he is to be laid-off.

Title: 543. Wehe wenn sie losgelassen...
description: Peter Holunder is rehearsing with his band for a jazz competition. Through a mix-up, the band receives an invitation to the Knax family's villa, where they get to showcase their talent.

Title: 544. El gran premio
description: An old lady participates in a TV game show, about poetry. But one of the questions she has to answer will be specially difficult not only for her knowledge but also for her heart.

Title: 545. Masters of the Congo Jungle
description: Documentary showing the struggles of the inhabitants--both human and animal--of what was then called the Belgian Congo.

Title: 546. Auferstehung
description: At the end of nineteenth century Russia, Prince Nechljudoff, on the verge of contracting a marriage of convenience, leads a superficial and mundane life. He is appointed juror in the trial of a woman he recognizes as Katjuschka, whom he once seduced and abandoned after making her pregnant.

Title: 547. Lukochuri
description: Twins navigate love and chaos in Mumbai. Hilarity ensues as they juggle relationships with sisters, leading to a heartwarming conclusion.

Title: 548. Imperfect Angel
description: Beate has a crush on her teacher Dr. Agast and uses Agast's son Dieter to get close to him. When Agast refuses her she claims he tried to rape her. The scandal is immense, Agast has to face trial. But how can he prove it's all a sham?

Title: 549. Sadhna
description: Mohan (Sunil Dutt) is the only bachelor son of his widowed mother and works as a professor. He is against prostitution and considers prostitutes a black spot on society. But due to some circumstances, a prostitute named Champabai (Vaijyantimala) comes to his life in the form of Rajni. Will Mohan and his ailing mother accept Champabai as Rajni or not?

Title: 550. Die Landärztin vom Tegernsee
description: German village gets a new doctor, but the conservative folk have trouble accepting a female for the job.

Title: 551. The Duke Wore Jeans
description: A cockney lad pretends to be a nobleman in order to woo a South American princess.

Title: 553. The Outlaws
description: Some months before the outbreak of the Greek Civil War three outlaws struggle for survival in the mountains.

Title: 554. Girls of the Night
description: A prostitute who has just been released from prison is murdered. The suspicions fall on the barman of the headquarters of the "caïds".

Title: 555. Wild Heritage
description: Two westward-bound families join forces to battle gunslingers.

Title: 556. La création du monde
description: A comedy about the creation of the universe in six days, with the devil messing around and contributing in his own way.

Title: 557. Sing Boy Sing
description: Manager Joseph Sharkey discovers a naive Virgil Walker who has an incredible vocal talent. Sharkey takes Virgil away from his humble beginnings, changes his appearance and turns him into a nationwide singing sensation.

Title: 558. Locos por la televisión
description: The arrival of television drives a whole community crazy. Countless comical situations arise to enter it.

Title: 559. It Happened One Night
description: Based on a true story, this almost documentary-like drama tells the story of a young doctor, who in 1942, helped several Jewish children escape over the German border to neutral Sweden. Not knowing who to trust and being pursued by the Germans, the flight quickly turns into a tense fight for their lives.

Title: 560. Girls on the Loose
description: Vera (Mara Corday) runs a nightclub that's really a front for her secret operation: an all-female crime ring that's been pulling off heist after heist. The gang does a major job with the help of Agnes (Abby Dalton), a new recruit and insider with access to a bank's payroll. But then the nervous Agnes threatens to squeal, so Vera has her rubbed out. And when Vera's good-girl sister, Helen (Barbara Bostock), starts dating suspicious policeman Bill (Mark Richman), Vera gets really cutthroat.

Title: 561. Mor skal giftes
description: When widow Inger Holm - owner of Holms Bryggerier - invites her children to a gathering, they show up. Not least because a handsome check usually falls to each of them. This time, however, the routines are turned around, as Inger has a man by her side, and the children's spoiled behavior makes her draw a line in the sand.

Title: 562. Maracaibo
description: In Venezuela during the 1950s, a vacationing Texas oilman is asked to help extinguish an oil derrick fire and he succumbs to the charms of a visiting New York novelist.

Title: 563. The Beast of Budapest
description: Re-creation of the Hungarian Revolution of 1956. A Hungarian militarist (Mylong) has a daughter (Rensing) who is an ardent communist. She loves Mills, who comes from a liberal family headed by his professor-father, Hoyt. The lovers are kept apart by their politics. "The Beast" in the title is Milton, who portrays the real man who kept an iron hand on the Hungarians.

Title: 564. Der schwarze Blitz
description: Michael Kirchner, nicknamed "The Black Lightning", is a passionate alpine skier. Now he must eliminate the tough opponent Herbert Tanner to be the representative of the national team.

Title: 566. La muralla
description: When Jorge overcomes a struck and feels his life might be in danger, he decides to confess an old fraud.

Title: 567. La vida por delante
description: Finished their careers of Law and Medicine, respectively, Antonio Redondo and Josefina Castro, a pair of young Spanish newlyweds, are looking for work to buy an apartment and start a life together, but they will face enormous difficulties throughout the process.

Title: 568. Tatort Berlin
description: Rudi Prange is released from prison for good behavior. He gets a job in a transport unit but gets involuntarily involved in a smuggling business by a colleague. When two police officers are gun down Rudi becomes the main suspect.

Title: 569. Hell's Five Hours
description: A disgruntled ex-employee of a missile fuel plant plans to commit suicide by blowing himself and the plant up with explosives.

Title: 570. El hombre que me gusta
description: A man facing bankruptcy and ruin rehearses a couple of scenarios relating to suicide, until his family convinces him he's worth more alive than dead.

Title: 571. Dragstrip Riot
description: After a run-in with a tough motorcycle gang, where Rick Martin (Gary Clarke) is blamed when one of the bikers is sent out of control over a cliff, he and his girl are threatened and pursued. On to the beach riot, where the real culprit is unmasked and retaliates with his spear gun.

Title: 573. Sampoorna Ramayanam
description: The story is the complete Ramayana from the birth of Lord Rama to his Pattabhisheka after completing his exile.

Title: 574. The Money Rich
description: An unpretentious owner of a travelling sideshow who receives an immense fortune from his long-forgotten brother indulges himself in the sweet pleasures of dolce vita. But, will he remember his humble origins?

Title: 575. Incognito
description: Bob Stanley was an American secret agent during World War II in France. After the war Stanley returns to France as a consul. In reality, he works for the FBI, to roll up the organization that manufactures fake U.S. dollars. A violent confrontation is insurmountable.

Title: 576. Diao Charn
description: Based on Romance of the Three Kingdoms, movie is a retelling of a familiar tale with iconic actress Linda Lin Dai (Lam Doi) in the titular role of Diau Charn, one of the four storied beauties of ancient China.

Title: 577. Onna de aru koto
description: Married for a decade, a couple have no child. He is a lawyer, however, and as a result of one of his cases has the daughter of an imprisoned man living with them. The girl, who is understated, has a boyfriend, but otherwise only ventures out to meet her jailed father. The family is visited by the daughter of a friend from Osaka who has made the journey without informing her parents. That her personality is the opposite of the girl who lives in the house is obvious. At the same time, the wife runs into her own ex and the husband faints at work due to exhaustion. The live-in girl tends to the husband in a way that leaves the latter's wife concerned.

Title: 578. Manhunt in the Jungle
description: Adventurer George M. Dyatt is sent to find a fellow adventurer, Colonel Percy Fawcett, who went missing in the Amazon jungle in 1925 while searching for the lost city of Z (changed to El Dorado in the movie). Based on true events.

Title: 579. Vater, Mutter und neun Kinder
description: A drunken flirt with another woman upsets the life of a devoted family man on the cusp of his 25th wedding anniversary.

Title: 580. Un ettaro di cielo
description: Severino is a young street vendor... He arrives in a small town where he flirts with all the women. The most beautiful girl in the village, Marina, is in love with him, but Severino doesn't want to commit to her. Severino is actually a scammer who sells table salt as if it were a miracle product. One day he convinces some old people of the village to buy a piece of heaven for when they die. But the old men decide to kill themselves in order to immediately exploit their purchase. So they set off on a boat to drown themselves in the lagoon. When Severino discovers their plans, he panics.

Title: 581. Eisenstein's Mexican Project
description: In 1930, a group of three Russians - Sergei Eisenstein, Grigori Alexandrov, and Eduard Tisse - began an ambitious film in Mexico. A year later the backers halted the project before filming was complete.

Title: 582. Amore e guai...
description: Three vignettes about couples trying to get together and the problems that continue to keep them apart.

Title: 583. Pan, amor y Andalucía
description: Determined to postpone his own wedding, a former marshal leaves his bride-to-be and participates in an international music festival in Spain, where he falls for a young dancer.

Title: 584. Dust in the Sun
description: After a policeman taking an Aborigine prisoner to trial is attacked and injured by other Aborigines, it sets of a chain of tragic events.

Title: 585. Muertos de miedo
description: Scared to Death: Viruta and Capulina work as janitors in a detective agency; they want to be private investigators themselves, so they study there as well. Alma, the millionaire who owns the detective agency hires Viruta and Capulina after they pass their exam. She entrusts them with their first assignment, which is to track down Rostov, a famous jewel thief and murderer with a $50,000 bounty on his head. Mrs. Tina, Alma's mother, doesn't like her daughter's profession and sets a trap for her with the intention of getting her married so she will forget once and for all about the detective agency. Can Viruta and Capulina solve their first case through good humor, innocence, and a sense of fun?

Title: 586. Zimbo
description: To search for any trace of his brother's missing boy, an adventurer and his daughter embark on a dangerous rescue mission, catching the eye of an elusive jungle-dwelling man. Could he be Tarzan, mighty protector of the jungle?

Title: 587. A Lady Mislaid
description: Esther and her sister Jennifer have just taken a remote country cottage. But there is strange gossip about the previous occupants.

Title: 588. Phir Subha Hogi
description: An adaption of Fyodor Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment; Ram is a destitute but bright law student who decides to rob the safe of the moneylender.

Title: 589. Escuela para suegras
description: Tin Tan is a drifter who one day rescues a boy from the river who turns out to be from a very wealthy family. Grateful, the family tries to help Tin Tan and seeks out what he hates most: a day job.

Title: 591. The Stowaway
description: A group of adventurers compete with one another to find the missing heir Rene Marechal, thought to be near Tahiti.

Title: 593. Intrepid Hero
description: 1950, PLA scout Tai Zeng disguised himself as a Taiwan agent to defeat the bandits in West Guangxi province.

Title: 594. Red Children
description: The film shows the events of 1934 during the Great Campaign of the Chinese Red Army. The film tells how young patriots - "red guys" grew stronger in the fight against enemies for the liberation of China.

Title: 595. Smiley Gets a Gun
description: A sequel to the movie Smiley (1956). Young Smiley gets into more strife as he attempts to prove himself a responsible citizen by helping others, so that he can earn a new gun from Sergeant Flaxman.

Title: 596. Desert Hell
description: In the Sahara desert, a French Legionnaires' captain disobeys orders and leads his patrol on a suicide mission, while he is in a personal conflict with his lieutenant.

Title: 597. El jinete solitario
description: A farmer is murdered and the criminal who killed him takes his identity to steal his land, but the son of the murdered man becomes a masked avenger.

Title: 599. Estranho Encontro
description: Two pairs of mismatched lovers wind up in a dangerous situation when the younger partners of each relationship meet by accident.

Title: 600. Guardia, ladro e cameriera
description: Otello, an amateur thief, tries a burglary on New Year Eve but he finds the maid Adalgisa in the supposedly empty house. Adalgisa likes Otello who, all things considered, is a good guy, unlike Amerigo the night watchman who tries to profit from the situation.

Title: 602. Gambe d'oro
description: Baron Luigi Fontana is a rich and stinging producer of fine wines, as well as president of the amateur football team of Cerignola who, to crown a triumphant championship, is about to be promoted to Serie C.

Title: 603. L'uomo dai calzoni corti
description: Salvatore, known as "bread loaf", escapes from Caltanissetta's brewery to find his mother he never met. Before arriving in Venice, he stays in a small sea village where he meets people of various kinds.

Title: 606. Mark of the Phoenix
description: A sample of an advanced new metal is stolen and made into a cigarette case in Brussels ready for smuggling to the East. An American jewel thief accidentally finds it in his possession and becomes the focus of unwanted attention.

Title: 607. Life as a Couple
description: The writer Pierre Carot became rich and famous with his book "Life as a Couple", which was based on the loving relationships of four couples. Now he's setting up his will and wants to leave his wealth to the couples among the four, which are still as deeply in love - if any: else, his companions get the money. He sends them out to visit the couples and test their love.

Title: 608. Totò e Marcellino
description: Marcellino becomes an orphan and finds two uncles--a good old eccentric man and a villain.

Title: 609. Slippery When Wet
description: Five California surfers embark on a dream trip to Hawaii, riding waves at top surfing spots and living together in a rundown North Shore shack on a tight budget.

Title: 610. All About Marriage
description: Ultra-perky model likes single freedom but feels ryosai kenbo ("good wife, wise mother") pressure, exemplified by her bored-to-tears sister

Title: 611. Ash Wednesday
description: A prostitute falls in love with an older man, who was a young priest during the Cristero War in Mexico in 1926-29.

Title: 612. The Mask of the Gorilla
description: Géo Paquet, aka The Gorilla, breaks from jail. Now an escaped convict, the elite agent must infiltrate a dangerous gang working for a foreign embassy as their leader, a spy enjoying diplomatic immunity, can't be arrested by regular police.

Title: 613. The Cool and the Crazy
description: High school thug is front man for a local marijuana ring.

Title: 614. King on Horseback
description: Henri La Tour, a strolling player, is also a daring adventurer. So, when, after accomplishing a brilliant feat, he is awarded a title by King Louis XV, the Duke of Saint-Sever takes offense at it and challenges Henri to a duel. However, while they fight, a group of Austrian soldiers appear suddenly and the two rivals instantly unite to repel their enemies. Unfortunately, Saint-Sever is mortally wounded and, feeling he is about to die, he entreats his new friend to offer protection to Toinon, his natural daughter, whose life is being threatened...

Title: 615. Cala a Boca, Etelvina
description: Alligator raiser from the state of Mato Grosso, Brazil, travels to his nephew's, and takes the maid Etelvina for his nephew's wife.

Title: 617. Malish gherak
description: Bassima is reluctant to marry. The trouble is that Faizy, her rich father, has decided that his younger daughters will not be allowed to marry until Bassima is united in holy matrimony herself. The latter urge their father to encourage Bassima to take the plunge. Faisy then starts writing Bassima anonymous love letters and little by little the girl grows fonder and fonder of the stranger who sends her such passionate missives. Following a misunderstanding, Bassima believes the sender is none other than Ahmed Atef, a handsome but poor singer.

Title: 619. Confessions of a College Student
description: At the idea of and with the assistance of her drama-loving detective-novel reading friend, penniless and desperate So-yeong cons a congressman into believing she is his lost daughter. As So-yeong completes her studies in law school, the suspicious congressman's wife does a little detective work of her own. So-yeong, racked with guilt, is determined to become a lawyer who helps women in similar situations as hers, but will she succeed? Or will the truth be revealed?

Title: 621. Far til fire og ulveungerne
description: Little Per has become a boy scout. As a boy scout he has to help other people in need, but things take a turn for the worse and Little Per goes missing. Now it is up to the family to find him...

Title: 622. Man from God's Country
description: A cattleman, through a deal with a friend, gets involved in a land-grab for a proposed railroad in Sundown, Montana in this classic Western starring George Montgomery.

Title: 623. Échec au porteur
description: After resolving to start a new life with his girlfriend Jacqueline, Bastien Sassey decides to give up working as a courier for drugs traffickers. So that he and Jacqueline can make a fresh start he agrees to take on one more job for a large sum of cash, but he betrays his employer.

Title: 624. Blitzmädels an die Front
description: During WWII The German 'Wehrmacht' is heavily under fire after the invasion of Normandy. There are also a lot of women participating in the war, working at the front line as couriers for the air force. In this war, everyday, they put their lives on the line.

Title: 625. Vacations in Aegina
description: When the capricious daughter of a suave journalist visits sunny Aegina, a chance encounter with a handsome aristocrat leads to an innocuous plan in the name of passion. Will she taste love's first kiss in the isle of incurable romantics?

Title: 626. Die Käserei in der Vehfreude
description: The farmers of a village decide to postpone the construction of a new school in profit of a concentration to cheese production.

Title: 627. Statocný zlodej
description: A man is accused of stealing money from the charity where he works.

Title: 628. Country Music Holiday
description: The story of a hillbilly singer's rise to fame.

Title: 630. Mia nonna poliziotto
description: Tina, an old lady, is in town for the wedding of her grandson when a medallion left to her by her late husband disappears. Dissatisfied with the police effort to find it, she sets on the tracks of the thieves herself.

Title: 631. Handle with Care
description: An idealistic young law student investigates an apparent tax fraud, and discovers that right and wrong isn't always a matter of black and white.

Title: 632. La noche y el alba
description: A poor photographer unhappy with his wife hopes for a chance with another woman but a tragedy results.

Title: 633. Se los chupó la bruja
description: Brothers Viruta and Capulina inherit, along with their distant cousin Reynaldo, an eerie mansion where a hidden treasure is located.

Title: 634. Jailor
description: A disfigured but compassionate and dedicated Jailor's life undergoes changes after his wife leaves with another male.

Title: 635. Dokuz Dagin Efesi: Çakici Geliyor
description: The events that started with the murder of Çakici Mehmet's father by Hasan Sergeant and the revenge plans of the young Efe.

Title: 637. Lan Lan and Dong Dong
description: About how kind people helped bring little Lanlan and her brother Dongdong to Beijing to their parents.

Title: 638. Un homme se penche sur son passé
639. Mimikos and Mary
description: Petros has come from Germany to marry Mary, which he didn't knows.On the day of the engagement, Peter's friend Michalis, meet Mair and they falls in love. A love that will face several problems.

Title: 640. Mit Eva fing die Sünde an
description: An actress feels uncomfortable with a love scene with the male partner in a stage play. The movie then shows men and women interacting through different stages of history.

Title: 641. The Ghost-Cat Cursed Wall
description: When a nobleman finds a woman to be an obstacle to his growing political influence, he kills her and her cat and has their bodies immured in a wall. Shortly afterwards, a catlike demon begins to haunt the castle.

Title: 642. Jazzgossen
description: Wealthy Teddy Anker invests in 1920s theater. His ventures succeed until producing a show starring dancer Karin, his love interest, which financially flops.

Title: 643. The Pirate of the Black Hawk
description: Manfred, backed by Saracen pirates, deposes the Duke of Montfort, takes over the throne and kidnapped the Duke's young son. Capt. Riccardo, the leader of a pirate band on the ship Black Hawk, sets out to defeat Manfred and his Saracens and restore the Duke to his rightful place on the throne.

Title: 644. Forever with You
description: Leaving prison in hopes of reuniting with his lover, a man finds instead that she has married his childhood rival, a now-crooked businessman.

Title: 648. Venganza
description: Simon sets out to avenge his bride's death at the hands of the bandit Martinico and by accident, he captures Martinico's bride-to-be Belen and uses her to find Martinico.

Title: 649. Der Mann, der nicht nein sagen konnte
650. Toto in the Moon
description: Two men embarks upon a space race. Their efforts are hampered by aliens who clone the heroes to keep them from exploring further.

Title: 651. Amore e chiacchiere (Salviamo il panorama)
description: An industrialist tries to corrupt the deputy mayor by exploiting his oratory vanity, to prevent the panoramic view of his villa from being disfigured by a hospice.

Title: 652. Non sono più Guaglione
description: A mechanic falls in love with a girl who aspires to become a diva.

Title: 654. Kapitanskaya dochka
description: This literary adaptation focuses on the life of a rebellious young man in Tsarist Russia.

Title: 655. Why Women Sin
description: After escaping from her reform school , young and comely Betty is reunited with her lover Frederic, a journalist. In search of pleasures and of the money that buys them, the young pair follow the wrong path, to disastrous consequences.

Title: 656. Mysteries of Black Magic
description: The stage magician Eglé Elohim offers a show that is causing a sensation in an old archaeology professor who comes to see her in the theater, who is also a great specialist in the history of magic, witchcraft and ancient rituals.

Title: 657. The Big Beat
description: Young man just out of college tries to persuade his father, who owns a record company, to start signing up rock 'n' roll acts.

Title: 658. Aquellos tiempos del cuplé
description: Mercedes Pavón, a popular singer, has several love interests along her life : a soldier, a nobleman and a politic go after her. She puts into songs her troubles and doesn't notice that her faithful composer is secretly in love with her.

Title: 659. Voice Without a Shadow
description: Ishikawa, a newspaper journalist, unexpectedly meets Asako, a woman who used to work for his company some time ago as a phone operator. Three years ago, she accidentally heard the voice of a suspect who committed a still-unresolved homicide. Since then, the suspect's voice has remained lodged in her mind as a terrifying memory. One night, her husband invites over his colleagues, Kawai, Hamazaki, and Muraoka. She realizes that Hamazaki's voice sounds exactly the same as the unseen suspect's! A few days later, Hamazaki is found dead in a rain-soaked coalfield; her husband is kept in police custody as the primary suspect. Ishikawa tries to help Asako and launches his own investigation. However, the investigation soon runs into difficulty as both Kawai and Muraoka had alibis. To make matters worse, her husband implausibly confesses

Title: 660. Sierra Baron
description: Set in 1848 California. About a brother and sister battling a crooked businessman over property rights.

Title: 661. El jefe
description: It is the story of a gang of juvenile petty criminals who find their "boss" to one capable of solving their problems and realize their wishes.

Title: 662. Cuatro en la frontera
description: A French National Treasury van is assaulted and they steal the gold bullion it was carrying. According to confidences received by the Police Headquarters of Barcelona, it seems that part of the gold is clandestinely introduced into Spain through the Pyrenees. In order to discover and eradicate such smuggling infiltration, an agent pretends to be a day laborer at a farm located on the border and in a suspicious area.

Title: 663. Maxime
description: In the early 1900s, a down-and-out French nobleman gets involved in romantic matchmaking that backfires in his favor.

Title: 664. Oyafukô dôri
description: A young delinquent wants to avenge his sister from a college student who abandoned her after leaving her pregnant. To do this, he decides to seduce the student's sister to make him suffer the same fate.

Title: 665. The Spaniard's Curse
description: A man is convicted of murder. He denies murder, and uses an ancient curse to threaten those responsible for sentencing him to death.

Title: 666. Gun Fever
description: Lucas (Stevens) and his partner Simon (John Lupton) set about to capture the renegade white man who caused the deaths of Lucas' parents in an Indian raid.

Title: 667. The Perfect Game
