description: A group of five college students decide to jinx a bicycle race in their favor and claim the money to pay off their debts, but when the illegal bookie cannot pay, they take up his offer of "collateral" as revenge and complexities begin to unravel and ruin their scheme.

Title: 669. Die Sklavenkarawane
description: In the Upper Nile region Kara and Halef fight the slave trader Abu El Mot. When their caravan is attacked they are captured, escape and free beautiful Senitza from a Harem. But Abu El Mot kidnaps her, with Kara and Halef in hot pursuit.

Title: 671. Vagabonderne paa Bakkegaarden
description: A world wanderer, who pays for food and coffee with a song, returns to the farm in Denmark he first worked at and fell in love with the farmer's daughter. She's now a widow and mother and her evil brother-in-law is running the farm.

Title: 672. Hell Squad
description: WWII drama set in Tunisia. Five American soldiers become separated from their unit without radio communication

Title: 673. The Diplomatic Corpse
description: London police and reporters from a local newspaper go after a gang of foreign criminals.

Title: 675. Three Friends
description: Three hopeless cronies from the slums help a blind panhandler girl who is homeless and hungry. The girl, an ingenue, brings a new hope to everyone's life, especially to the one who falls in love with her.

Title: 676. Hoch klingt der Radetzkymarsch
description: In Biedermeier Vienna, Oberleutnant Fischbacher has fallen in love with the steadfast chambermaid Franzi, who of course rejects him. When he hears that she is said to have heard someone else, he is disappointed and composes a hit song about the immorality of Viennese parlor maids. The little song becomes a hit, but the objects of ridicule are only moderately enthusiastic and go on strike for the upcoming Radetzkyball.

Title: 677. Talaaq
description: School-teacher Indu lives a middle-class lifestyle along with her widower and unemployed dad, Moolchand Chabbe. They rent the upper floor of the building and her dad makes it his duty to prevent anyone from occupying the lower floor so as not to tamper with the flow of the municipal water pipe-line. Ravi Shankar Chaube, a Poet and an Engineer by profession succeeds in renting the lower floor, impresses Indu so much so that she falls in love with him, and with Moolchand's conditional blessing that he live with them as a Ghar Jamai, both get married. Indu quits her job, and after sometime they become parents of a boy and name him Ashoo. Four years later differences surface as Moolchand spends a lot of Ravi's hard-earned money gambling. Things escalate to such an extent that Ravi puts everyone on a strict budget forcing Indu to get her job back. An enraged Ravi then asks Indu to make a choice - either quit the job or else face divorce proceedings.

Title: 678. The Hot Angel
description: In attempting to discover who's sabotaging the success of his company's uranium claims, a pilot becomes the conspirator's next victim.

Title: 679. Otaraant qvrivi
description: The only son of Otari's widow decides to serve in the serf owner's house, and falls in love with the patron's daughter for whom he can't reveal his feelings to.

Title: 680. Sayedat el kasr
description: A chance meeting at an auction brings together Sawsan (Faten Hamama), a working class girl and Adel (Omar Sharif), heir to a vast fortune with several estates to his name. This leads to a whirlwind marriage. This development spells trouble for Adel's fair-weather bourgeois clique, who are used to manipulating him with their own financial interests at heart.

Title: 681. Sultan
description: Sultan, a military orderly working for a general, is wrongly accused of theft and desertion. Failing to prove his innocence, he turns to crime - only for fate to lead him into an unexpected confrontation.

Title: 682. Música de siempre
description: The film is a combination of acts strung together with a story of a theater janitor, played by the comedian Manuel Valdes, who tries to persuade two film producers to make a movie about music. Among the entertainers he suggests for the movie is Libertad Lamarque, Toña la Negra, Edith Piaf, and nine-year old Angélica María, along with Altia Michel, German Valdes, Agustín Lara, Alejandro Algara and Tongolele.

Title: 683. Kurenai no tsubasa
description: Aviation themed adventure film that was a huge blockbuster in Japan (one of the biggest commercial hits of the 50s) and at times plays out like an American b-movie.

Title: 684. Lyubimetz 13
description: The main heroes are twin brothers. The first is responsible young fellow and excellent footballer. The second one is an undependable gambler. The police are after him. A pretty girl stands in between them. She has profoundly fallen for the footballer. By coincidence, the twins change places, which result in a formidable mess and funny situations. Ultimately, all the misunderstandings are settled and the couple re-joins.

Title: 685. Cetiri kilometra na sat
description: A bleak prewar environment of Yugoslavian provincial town dealing with local election during 1930s.

Title: 686. Sadhak Bamakhyapa
description: Sadhak Bamakhyapa is a 1958 Indian Bengali film, directed by Narayan Ghosh. The film stars Gurudas Banerjee, Molina Debi, Chhabi Biswas, Nitish Mukherjee, Kanu Bhattacharya, Padma Debi, Tulsi Chakraborty, Menoka Debi, Nripati Chatterjee, Haridhan Mukherjee, and Mihir Bhattacharya in lead roles. The film has musical score by Anil Bagchi.

Title: 687. Andre folks børn
description: The sympathetic farmers couple, Mads and Katrine (Hass Christensen and Malberg) are marked by their daughter's death. Katrine have to avoid other children. When Mads invites six city children for the summer holiday, however, old traumas are recovered.

Title: 688. Høysommer
description: The withdrawn painter Rasmus works at a remote lighthouse when he finds a rowboat with an unconscious woman seemingly having tried to commit suicide. He wants to report her to the police, but she begs him not to, before he falls in love.

Title: 690. Villa!!
description: The story of Pancho Villa's early years as a bandit, before he became a hero of the Mexican Revolution.

Title: 691. Ein Mädchen von 16 ½
description: The young orphan Helga is raised by her aunt after WW II. At the age of sixteen, she turns her back to go her own way. As a rambler, Helga wanders through the night streets of Berlin and has brief acquaintances.

Title: 692. Gräfin Mariza
description: Paying a rare visit to her estate, a countess clashes with the man she hired to manage it.

Title: 693. Wonderful Things
description: No longer able to make a living as a fisherman, Gibraltan Carmelo goes to London to seek his fortune.

Title: 696. Lilli - ein Mädchen aus der Großstadt
description: Based on the historical German doll/cartoon character, Bild Lilli. The titular character is portrayed as a reporter sent to a missionary convention that soon develops into a murder case.

Title: 697. Langya shan wu zhuang shi
description: Five soldiers of the Eighth Route Army fight heroically to cover the evacuation of local people from border area between Shanxi and Hebei provinces as the Japanese attack.

Title: 698. Es war die erste Liebe
description: The young and shy Peter attends a seminary because he fully embraces his faith in God and absolutely wants to serve in the Catholic Church. He is about to be ordained a priest and would like to spend a few more carefree days in the Schleswig-Holstein countryside before turning his back on all worldly things for the rest of his life. There he gets to know the Bergmann family, which also includes the beautiful, just 17-year-old daughter of the house, Annika, a blonde bombshell.

Title: 699. Baghi Sipahi
description: A Roman military commander falls in love with Ranjana, a devout Christian. The Roman Empire's atrocities toward the Christians prompt the commander to become a rebel soldier to protect the Christian community from the Roman Emperor.

Title: 700. Soapbox Derby
description: Children's drama. A children's gang in London called The Battersea Bats decide to build a car and enter it in a soapbox derby. A rival gang The Victoria Victors hear about the car and set out to steal it's plans.

Title: 701. Love in the Sand Dunes
description: The tragic love of Anna and a prison breaker.

Title: 703. Maya Manithan
description: A young working-class man drinks an invisibility potion and becomes a masked vigilante in order to bring a ruthless crime boss to justice.

Title: 704. Wenn die Conny mit dem Peter
705. Secret Post in Canton
description: A special agent of frontier force in Canton tries to find a spy called aunt Mei.

Title: 706. Habib hayati
description: Mamdouh inherits a huge wealth from his father, but he squanders it on nightclubs. When he's about to be bankrupt, his private secretary helps him out by giving him his wife's savings. He tries starting his life again.

Title: 707. Letters from China
description: About the way of life in the East, in China, during the months before spring. An early spring.

Title: 709. Going Steady
description: Two high school students manage to keep their marriage a secret from their family and friends, but that all changes when she becomes pregnant.

Title: 710. She Didn't Say No
description: Bridget Monaghan, a dressmaker and mother of six illegitimate children, tries to maintain her current lifestyle while the fathers of her six children try to run her out of their small Irish town and her children seek to gain lives of their own--and the lonely Bridget seeks a romance for herself.

Title: 711. Jedini izlaz
description: A group of partisans goes to destroy a German gas warehouse at Postojnska Jama. One of them grows distrustful towards the new commander, and it spreads among the rest of the squad. The situation culminates when the mentioned partisan remains cut off inside a cave.

Title: 712. Aji Bas Shukriya
description: Geeta belongs to a poor family and lives with her mother in a small one room apartment. She is employed as a typist with an organization. She likes to dance and sing, and does so also at work, which ends up in her losing her job. Her boss' son, Suresh, finds out about her dancing skills, and hopes to utilize her talents as a singer and dancer in a drama company, which she accepts. She becomes quite ppopular in a short period of time, and is expected to replace the current lead heroine. The lead heroine, along with her friends, cannot accept this, and abduct her. Now Geeta has a choice - give up acting, singing and dancing, or die.

Title: 713. Dorogoy moy chelovek
description: The doctor Vladimir Ustimenko is the person of a debt and honor, he is devoted to business to which serves, and is devoted to the one and only love which carries by through all life: love to Varya Stepanova, the eccentrical little girl who is dreaming to become the great actress, but become the geologist. War will cruelly interfere with the fate of heroes and will even more confuse in them, already fragile, the relations. After long and unexpected separation heroes will for the first time meet in front hospital where the army doctor Ustimenko will operate not recovering consciousness "difficult" patient - Varya Stepanova.

Title: 714. El akh el kabir
description: Awad secretly leads a drug gang while pretending to have a respectable job to support his mother, brother Ahmed, and cousin Dawlat. Roheya, a dancer, is eager to marry him, but he resists since Ahmed is nearing graduation from law school.

Title: 715. Police
description: A Special Task Police Inspector, disguised as a deceased gangster, infiltrates an enigmatic criminal group to apprehend its elusive members.

Title: 716. Sawaq Nos El Lail
description: The powerful Nargis falls for Hassan, a truck driver, and tries to seduce him, but he stays loyal to his fiancée, Badriya. When he rejects Nargis's advances, she plots to ruin him with the help of Elewa and her gang.

Title: 718. Undercover Girl
description: A journalist pieces together clues which lead to the eventual downfall of a sophisticated blackmail ring.

Title: 719. Los tres vivales
description: In a Mexican village, a trio of gunslingers converge to settle a score. Their mission: determine who among them reigns supreme as the fastest draw and most accurate shot.

Title: 720. Diamond Safari
description: In Johannesburg, South Africa, adventurer Harry Jordan is asked by a native medicine man to help a young woman from Zululand whose husband, Stephen Timbu, has been accused of murdering a fellow gold miner in a drunken rage. When Harry goes to the police headquarters to examine the case records, Sgt. van der Cliffe shows him an enraged Timbu and his badly beaten cellmate. The evidence suggests that Timbu is guilty so Harry advises his wife to return home as there is nothing he can do. Later, Harry encounters Jan Reubens, an investigator for mining syndicates, who tells him that it is important for his current client to establish Timbu's innocence or guilt. Reubens explains that the man Timbu murdered was a member of a diamond smuggling ring, then pays Harry to resume his investigation. Harry goes to the mine where Timbu worked, talks with the manager, then goes underground to question Timbu's shift boss who knows him well. In a newly opened tunnel, Harry narrowly escapes death in a rock fall, which a friend of Timbu's says was no accident. Later, at a tribal dance, Harry finds a witness to Timbu's fight and learns that a part of a dancer's costume, a harness with bells, was found at the crime scene. As the dancers perform, Harry spots one with a torn harness and questions the man, from the Koza tribe, who runs off. Harry pursues him to the mine's waste materials dam, where he is captured and arrested. Although Timbu is released and rejoins his wife and baby, Reubens is unable to connect the murderer to the smuggling ring, but when he and Harry search the killer's shack they find an album with photos from a Rhodesian ranch owned by a man named Williamson, who Reubens suspects may be the leader of the ring. Reubens then sends Harry to Rhodesia to investigate Williamson, whom he meets by feigning an automobile breakdown. Williamson invites Harry to stay at his ranch where he explains that all of his native helpers have fled because of a lion in the area. Williamson, who has been drinking heavily, has killed many lions, but fears this one, as he believes that it has supernatural powers and is trying to avenge the deaths of the other lions. When Harry and Williamson go to track the lion, Williamson becomes fearful, prompting Harry to tell him that the lion will follow him the rest of his life unless he faces it now. Upon finding the lion, they discover that it is old and dying and surrounded by vultures. Williamson declines to shoot it but, when the lion suddenly attacks, kills it. Later, Harry questions Williamson about the Koza tribesman and learns that he was discharged for stealing by Williamson's foreman, Kennedy, who is now missing. Harry communicates the information to Reubens, who tells him that Kennedy's dead body has been found in Kimberley. Reubens now believes that Williamson was a false lead and sends Harry to Kimberley, where Carlton, the head of criminal investigation for the diamond mine, tells him that unpolished diamonds along with an address in Durban were found on Kennedy's body. Carlton provides Harry with a phony identity and asks him to pose as a friend of Kennedy and deliver the diamonds. Carlton's men intend to step in and arrest the recipient after Harry hands over the diamonds. At the Durban address, Harry is met by American Louise Saunders. When Harry tells Louise he has a package of diamonds for her, she does not take the bait and asks him to leave. However, later at his hotel, Harry finds Louise and her sinister accomplice Doc, a Nazi who performed experiments on prisoners of war, waiting for him with a gun. Louise informs Harry that she has checked his background and now wants the diamonds. As Harry has returned the diamonds to Carlton, he arranges to hand them over the following day. Police listen in as Doc examines the diamonds and offers to buy them for £2,000 to be paid later in the day at Louise's apartment. However, when Harry meets Louise she insists that they first go on a sightseeing tour of the city. In the Indian quarter, they get to know each other over a meal in a restaurant and although they embrace, Louise does not produce the cash. The next day, when Harry, faced with the dilemma of still having to entrap Louise, tries to avoid her, Carlton reminds him that she and Doc have left a trail of blood behind them. Harry arranges to meet Louise and Doc at the restaurant, where Doc is quietly detained by the police. With Carlton at an adjacent table, Louise invites Harry to leave with her for Europe and suggests that they can support themselves by selling narcotics. After Harry hands over the diamonds and receives the cash from Louise, Carlton arrests her. However, Doc escapes from custody and, as Harry and Carlton lead Louise down an alley, shoots at them. They return fire, killing Doc, then discover that he has fatally shot Louise.

Title: 721. Samrat Chandragupt
description: This movie depicts the personal life of Samrat Chandragupt, his trials, tribulations, and frustrations, as well as the challenges he faces to reclaim his kingdom; face-off the threat from Sikander; enlist the assistance of the Yunani Greeks; his love for Helena; and be forced to make a decision of beheading his own mother as per the laws of the land.

Title: 722. Et ta soeur
description: Bastien du Boccage is a repeat offender: hasn't he been sent to jail no fewer than six times? But he is no ordinary criminal mind you. As a matter of fact he is a newspaper editor and should have no problems with justice. The trouble is that he has a sister, Lucrèce, who is agony aunt in his newspaper and who tends not to mince her words. To make matters worse, Francine, his daughter, has fallen in love with Bruno, a penniless student and Lucrèce is prepared to do anything to prevent her marriage...

Title: 726. Factory B
description: A group of oil drillers of the Factory B, focused on success rather than praise, strive to find the oil despite the decision on the suspension of the drilling works.

Title: 727. Heart of a Child
description: A boy's love for his dog in face of his father's opposition.

Title: 728. Mientras el cuerpo aguante
description: When her employer dies, a maid inherits his fortune, but a nephew of the deceased tries to take all the possessions from her.

Title: 729. Hei shan zu ji zhan
description: In 1948 Chinese Communists and Nationalists battle for Northeast China.

Title: 730. Black Tide
description: Two swimmers are attempting to swim across the English Channel when one of them disappears. The other swimmer is convinced that it was no accident, and insists on investigating himself, even though the police do not believe him.

Title: 731. Hot Car Girl
description: Instead of working for a living, Duke and Freddie steal auto accessories and sell to a fence. While Duke is out driving with his girl Peg, she tries to dissuade him from a life of crime. Angered, he taunts her with another girl, Janice, who has driven up alongside him, and they have a race. A motorcycle policeman who is chasing them is killed when he crashes into Janice's car, and she is held. Duke, who has driven off, paints his black car light blue to escape detection. Janice learns his license number, and in fear of being discovered, Duke kills her. Duke coerces Peg to leave town with him, committing holdups along the way. Realizing his luck will not hold out, but unwilling to surrender, Duke sends Peg back and remains alone in an abandoned roadside fruit stand, awaiting his fate.

Title: 732. Los clarines del miedo
description: Filigranas and Aceituno are two bullfighters hired for an amateur bullfight in a little town of Castile. Filigranas is a young man with enthusiasm and a huge desire to succeed; Aceituno, oldest, is disenchanted with the fiesta since he is afraid of bulls. Walking through the village, they meet Fina, an attractive young woman, and Filigranas promises that he will dedicate her a bull if she attends the bullfight.

Title: 733. Tôkyô no kyûjitsu
description: May Kawaguchi is a famous Japanese fashion designer. Returning to Tokyo from her home in New York, she travels incognito with a tour group, in hopes of having a quiet vacation without being noticed. But she is spotted and the press has a field-day with the returning celebrity. Her hopes of rest shattered, she agrees to put on a large-scale fashion show.

Title: 734. Der Maulkorb
description: The story takes place during the imperial era in a Rhineland city. The regional ruler has just railed against freedom of speech. At the regulars' table in the tavern, where the public prosecutor is also sitting, the citizens express their outrage while consuming copious amounts of wine. The next morning, the prince's statue is found wearing a muzzle.

Title: 735. She's a Lunatic
description: After breaking up with her boyfriend, a lively young woman stumbles upon an affluent man and pretends to be rich. Before long, she hosts a party at a villa and hires her employer as her father. But, what happens if he finds out her lie?

Title: 736. Hatamoto taikutsu otoko
description: Master swordsman and loyal 'Hatamoto' (direct vassal to the shogun), Saotome Mondonosuke, is sent to investigate an intrigue centering on the Date Clan.

Title: 739. So ein Millionär hat's schwer
description: An unconventional millionaire falls in love with an ordinary girl. To make sure she will love him for himself and not his money he disguises himself as a poor painter.

Title: 740. Malinconico autunno
description: Lucas is an orphan who lives with his mother Mary, a worker in a factory in Barcelona. One day they meet Captain Andres.

Title: 741. The Girls Are Willing
description: On the idyllic Birkø lives Christian a parish executive officer. He is a brave and honest man, happily married to Martha, and this couple has a son called Theo and he will once take over the farm.

Title: 742. The Man in the Moonlight Mask
743. Sumpah Pontianak
description: Based on a Malay folklore about a vampire who emerges after the death of a woman during childbirth, the 'pontianak'.

Title: 744. Operation Abduction
description: A French rocket scientist has invented a formula for fuel that will erase all other sources of energy - so valuable that his Government, foreign spies and crooked businessmen want to get their hands on him - first.

Title: 745. The Power of the Resurrection
description: A young man, Facing torture and possibly death for his Christian beliefs, confesses his fears to Peter, who awaits a similar fate. Peter tells him of fear he felt in following Jesus' arrest in the Garden of Gethesamene, when he denied knowing him three times - and yet Jesus told him that he would be the rock upon which the Church was built. Peter goes on to relate the events of the passion week, including the Christ's crucifixion, resurrection and ascension.

Title: 746. Novye pokhozhdeniya Kota v Sapogakh
description: Girl Luba had a dream. She, the daughter of a chess king in a fairyland, became the victim of a cunning political conspiracy of two cards - the Peak Jack Krivello and the Cross Dame Dvuliche.

Title: 748. Gli zitelloni
description: Marcello is engaged to Gina, the daughter of the boarding house where he lives, but he is undecided whether to marry her or not.

Title: 749. ¿Adónde van nuestros hijos?
description: A family problem picture: A mother has one son involved with student turmoil, another who flirts with an American girl ("una gringita").The wife is about ready to leave her husband.

Title: 750. Ladrones de niños
description: Infamous thieves go to the extreme of separating children from their mothers, with the intention of selling them for a sum of money.

Title: 751. Khazanchi
description: For the world famous newspaper, the «Sunday Times», an English team of museum specialists determined the ten best museums of this world - Austria's Natural History Museum of Vienna was within the top ten.

Title: 752. Desnúdate, Lucrecia
description: An artist and her fiancé go to Acapulco for a weekend, and she discovers that their engagement was a mistake.

Title: 753. Spion 503
description: During World War II, the sexy June Harvey (Margit Carlqvist) is a smooth operator within the Nazi ranks as well as within the growing resistance movement. Loosely based on real world person Jane Horney.

Title: 754. Schwarze Nylons - Heiße Nächte
description: The crooked Sabri, manager for the female dancers of the Seven Blue Stars are booked at the Alhambra in Tangier. Cilly find out about Sabri's shady plans and is now found dead in the harbor. Sabri have the girls passports in his pocket.

Title: 756. Shabab el-Yom
description: Fathiyyah is the family's spirit as she takes care of her sick father. She loves the young doctor treating him. One day, her brother discovers that Fathiyyah is not his sister, but she was adopted by his parents from a shelter. On the day of engagement with the doctor, the brother drinks some whiskey and loses his senses, telling Fathiyyah the truth that turns her life upside down.

Title: 758. Luban De Chuanshuo
description: Lu Ban, the father of carpentry of China, lived in the Warring States Period more than two thousand years ago. During his travel through the land, he has solved many architectural problems and befriends a young builder. Under the guidance of Lu, the young man slowly turns from an arrogant and imprudent builder into a responsible craftsman able to take on a daunting task assigned by the king.

Title: 760. Devushka s gitaroy
description: Near the pretty saleswoman of the music store Tanechka Fedosova, who dreams of becoming an actress, there are always a lot of customers. But they irritate the director, who is afraid of losing a valuable employee. He tries to prevent Tanya's possible career, which has all the data to become an actress. The acquaintance of a girl with a young composer helps her dream come true.

Title: 761. Ch. P. - Chrezvychainoe proisshestvie
description: The crew of a soviet cargo falls prey to an act of piracy in waters between China and Taiwan, and are taken to Taiwan where they are pressured into stating they chose to go into the free world.

Title: 763. Chéri, fais-moi peur
description: A crime story writer comes to the French Alps for vacation. However, an envelope given by a strange man, would put him in a conflict between two teams of spies. A young blonde hotel burglar will help him get out of this mess.

Title: 764. Yoru no sugao
description: An ambitious young woman manipulates everyone around her to become a famous choreographer in the world of traditional Japanese dancing.

Title: 766. El diario de mi madre
description: On her 15th birthday party, a young girl is about to runaway with an older man when she founds her mom's diary that tells the real story of her life as a dancer.

Title: 767. Night Club
description: When Bindu's brother is murdered by a night club owner, she decides to take things in her own hands to avenge his death. The film offers a rare window into how and whether she will succeed when she is dealing with an omnipotent villain.

Title: 768. Death Over My Shoulder
description: A private detective, desperate for money to pay for an operation on his small son, bargains with a protection gangster chief to have himself killed and gets his girl to collect the insurance money.

Title: 769. Mangalya Balam
description: Saroja and Chandrasekhar loves each other. But when she comes to know that they were already married during their childhood, keeps a distance from him. So Chandrasekhar tries to clear all the problems to live happily with Saroja.

Title: 770. Fatima
description: A newborn girl was exposed to Ossetian prince. Several years passed away. Beauty Fatima and prince's son Dzhambulat fell in love.

Title: 771. É de Chuá
description: Typical Brazilian musical comedy of the 50s, having the carnival as theme and featuring great names of Brazilian music and radio.

Title: 772. Io, mammeta e tu
description: In 1950s Naples (more Italian than Italy itself), a couple struggles to be together against--of course!--the will of the mother-in-law. In the end, not only will they be together, but the mother-in-law-to-be, a widow, finds love as well--although the fellow needs to pass the scrutiny of his own mother-in-law-to-be.

Title: 773. Dangerous Games
description: A poor girl in Paris's Menilmontant neighborhood needs to get a lawyer for her brother, accused of killing a cop.She and her cronies kidnap a spoiled youth, the only son of a bourgeois couple, he's gone to the area to study violin.

Title: 774. Ana dice sí
description: Juan does not have a penny, but he lives wonderfully. Their nights of revelry and cabaret are famous in the nocturnal circles of the city. As heir to his elderly and wealthy uncle don Patricio, he is subsidized by his creditors on account of the future inheritance. But Juan keeps a terrible secret: he has long been disinherited. When a telegram arrives announcing the death of the uncle, Juan returns to the family home on the Catalan Costa Brava. There he meets Ana, a wonderful woman, who is the current heiress of the family fortune.

Title: 775. Shirasagi
description: The story follows Oshino, a geisha who is trying to start a new life with a lover who is a painter. However, her past filled with debts and pimps catches up to her.

Title: 776. Dikenli Yol
description: The disastrous relationship of two families who are neighbors in the village to Istanbul.

Title: 777. Now That April's Here
description: Love stories abound in Toronto, Ontario.

Title: 778. Priestess with the Sullied Flesh
description: At a religious school, Eri finds connection with new student Anna. They act on their feelings, but their love triggers jealousy and rivalry. A tender, camp, unexpectedly queer cinematic discovery.

Title: 781. Tilman Riemenschneider
description: This historical biographical film celebrates Tilman Riemenschneider, one of the greatest German sculptors of the late Middle Ages.

Title: 782. O Grande Momento
description: On the day of his wedding, young man from a family of immigrants faces some problems to get the money needed for the last arrangements. The family do what they can in order to honour the great event, selling personal belongings and buying enough supplies for a decent party.

Title: 783. No Place to Land
description: A cropduster pilot finds himself caught between two women--one who loves him and the other, who doesn't handle rejection well, who's out to destroy him.

Title: 784. Man with a Gun
description: After a nightclub is burned to the ground, a detective is assigned by an insurance company to find the cause. The detective suspects the club owner of torching the place, but meets the club owner's niece, who helps the detective uncover a mob protection scheme that's responsible.

Title: 785. Dokufu Takahashi Oden
description: Biopic of female Japanese murderer Takahashi Oden.

Title: 786. El caso de una adolescente
description: Adolescents Alicia and Rafael make love without protection and decide to have their child in spite of their stern families, but things take a dramatic turn when the Rafael suddenly dies..

Title: 787. Alle Sünden dieser Erde
description: Regine ,a physician, loses her lover in a car crash and carries out an abortion;it's the beginning of her descent into hell.

Title: 790. Tokyo Bus Girl
description: Mineko is a tour guide on the Hato sightseeing lines, who, through a turn of events, suddenly becomes famous as the 'Lucky Bus Girl', and finds herself meeting an array of surprising characters when thrown into one unexpected situation after another. TOKYO BUS GIRL was inspired by a popular Japanese song of the same name that was released the previous year, which endures to this day.

Title: 791. Die Trapp-Familie in Amerika
description: The von Trapp family are struggling to survive in America, where their performances of European church music are not popular with the audiences. Only when they start performing more upbeat Austrian folk songs and even some American numbers do they become a success and finally find security and a new home.

Title: 792. Das Dreimäderlhaus
description: The young composer Franz Schubert tries to gain a foothold in Vienna.

Title: 793. Chofer de Praça
description: Zacarias and his wife go to São Paulo help their son who wants to be a Doctor. There, he lives a lot of funny adventures as a taxi driver.

Title: 794. Te noci
description: Following an accident in the mine on New Year's Eve, the task of bringing oxygen to the buried miners is to be performed. Driven by jealousy, Pavle founds himself in a dilemma of killing his wife's former lover, or saving the miners' lives.

Title: 795. A Slope in the Sun
description: A college aged woman arrives in Tokyo to study while finding work at the wealthy Tashiro family home as a tutor of the daughter, while the two brothers vie for her attention.

Title: 796. Seksdagesløbet
description: Semi documentary on a famous cycle race in Copenhagen. The story is about the competition between the riders as well as about their private and marital struggles.

Title: 797. Musik ombord
description: Ulla Winther has retired from her singing career to a marriage with two children. But her agent wants her to return and she finally agrees to take part in a charity concert.

Title: 799. Clara et les méchants
description: A rich kid ,the daughter of an oil tycoon ,lives a life of luxury.Bad guys kidnap the heiress .

Title: 800. Two and a Half Angels
description: Two homeless boys take in a baby, the son of a wealthy family, who is accidentally abandoned by his nanny.

Title: 801. Il cielo brucia
description: The Sky is Burning (1958). In Northern Africa, 1940, an Italian captain in command of a squadron of bombers is forced to land in an area occupied by the allies.

Title: 802. Funda
description: The dramatic story of bureaucrat Kenan and his wife Fehiman, who were crippled by an accident in Europe.

Title: 804. Su desconsolada esposa
description: The guards of a cemetery discover that a recently buried person is alive and when they unearth him, many things begin to be discovered.

Title: 805. Sharia el hub
description: A poor graduated singer struggling to get his chance, disguises into an old music teacher to work in a girl's school. A bet is launched between two of the leading students to trap this teacher into their affection.

Title: 806. Confess, Dr. Corda
description: A doctor goes to meet a beautiful girl at a park bench near a wooded area. When he arrives, he finds her battered body lying next to a stream. He then finds himself to be the prime suspect.

Title: 808. Joy Ride
description: Teenage story of a bad apple in a barrel evolving from a kid's desire to drive a new T-bird.

Title: 809. Les vignes du seigneur
description: Now Gisèle Bourjeon is the mistress of the count Hubert Martin de Kardec.After a long journey abroad Henri Lévrier, a champagne producer has come back and meets again his friends Hubert and the Bourjeon family.And surprise, Henri doesn't drink alcohol anymore.He says Gisèle that he was drinking because he loved very much.Henri and Gisèle feel well together and become lovers.

Title: 810. Tri koraka u prazno
description: A boatman who worked for others all his life gets into smuggling of luxury watches so he could earn enough for old age. A girl he loves and money is all that he wants, yet one dawn separates him from his dream...

Title: 811. Guitarras de medianoche
description: Al son de la música y de situaciones cargadas de tragi-comedia, un enmascarado ha estado robando a Luís y reparte su botín a los pobres. Sin embargo un día se llevará la sorpresa de su vida.

Title: 812. Karigar
description: A rich man eagerly awaits fatherhood and rejoices at his son's birth, but the baby's ID gets lost.

Title: 813. Delo bylo v Penkove
description: Take care of your husband attentively, even if you are the best woman in your village. Otherwise another woman from a town will take him immediately. And other advice on how to save your husband from the desperate zootechnician Tonya.

Title: 814. Carmela è una bambola
description: Carmela defies her father who wants her to marry Baron Prospero and sleepwalks every night to Toto's room.

Title: 815. Das Mädchen vom Moorhof
description: Helga is a young single lady who has a baby with a much older married man.

Title: 816. Would-Be Gentleman
description: Filmed theater version of the Moliere classic: A well off but ignorant bourgeois tries to move into aristocratic society by learning music, dance, fencing, philosophy.He is conned by masqueraders pretending to be Turks.

Title: 818. Inshalla: Razzia Am Bosporus
description: An Interpol agent fighting smugglers in Istanbul.

Title: 820. Vi på Väddö
description: Ylva has received her law degree. She rents a cottage on the island Väddö. This is a negative surprise for her fiance Bengt who has planned a trip to the continent.

Title: 822. Dulhan
description: Sharda forcefully marries Anokhe lal because of her aunt. One day she runs away and meets Mohan, who himself has broken up from with his fiance. They find love in each other but face trouble.

Title: 823. Pia de' Tolomei
description: Pia de' Tolomei, despite being in love with Ghino Perticari, was forced to marry a nobleman from Siena who, when he discovers her love for the other man, has her locked up in a tower.

Title: 825. Them Nice Americans
description: An American airman and an English girl wish to get married. The girl's mother is reasonably enthusiastic, but her father, an officer in the British police force, is totally opposed to the union.

Title: 827. Vasvirág
description: A shop girl falls in love with a well-meaning but homeless man, but eventually her boss blackmails her into a relationship.

Title: 829. Sabaash Meena
description: Its a story about a simple poor girl who manages to change a rich spoilt brat, making him a responsible person.

Title: 830. Du är mitt äventyr
description: Two journalists marry but the husband grows unhappy when he is left to take care of their child and she focuses on her career.

Title: 831. Senior Prom
description: The story of a student who becomes a disc-star and finds romance.

Title: 833. Ravina
description: A woman, who believes she has a curse, sees an engineer die in an accident while building a bridge. Considering two men who were courting her responsible for the tragedy, she decides to take revenge on both. Brazilian version of Brontë's Wuthering Heights.

Title: 834. Wind, Woman and Road
description: A meeting between two traveling gamblers leads to a case of mistaken identity that has deadly consequences.

Title: 835. Jenny
description: Jenny gets pregnant, but her lover doesn't want to become a father yet.

Title: 836. Galini
description: The film is based on the novella by the same name, written by Ilias Venezis and reflects the innermost bitterness of the Asia Minor Disaster. The doctor Dimitris Vellis and his younger wife, Eirini, who come from Asia Minor, settle in Anavyssos, as do many other refugees. Eirini, instead of cultivating foodstuffs - grain, grapevines or garden produce, as the government recommends, prefers to cultivate roses.

Title: 837. Hong Kong Affair
description: An American businessman travels to Hong Kong to find out why his tea plantation isn't making money. After he gets there, he discovers that his business partner has been growing something on the plantation, but it isn't tea. Starring Jack Kelly and May Wynn.

Title: 838. The Witch from Beneath the Sea
description: Seeking material for a best-seller, an author travels to South America, accompanied by his attractive secretary. Soon after their arrival, they witness an ancient legend spring to life when a beautiful girl is washed ashore.

Title: 839. Der Priester und das Mädchen
description: The new village priest gets entangled in a complicated romantic triangle involving a local noble family's paraplegic daughter.

Title: 840. Cara de Fogo
description: A family moves to a farm and witnesses some cattle thefts, then being chased by the criminal responsible for the crimes.

Title: 841. A sablazo limpio
description: Clumsy blacksmiths Cornelius and Crispín become the sidekicks of a masked hero who plans to unravel the frauds of a churlish military captain.

Title: 843. Napoli, sole mio!
description: Lorella must marry Dr. Matteini, but when she goes to Naples to meet him, she meets Michele, who sings in restaurants. The fateful spark is ignited, and although Michele is poor, Lorella decides to marry him against his mother's wishes. Michele is successful as a singer, but the mother remains granite in her refusal to communicate with Lorella--until he birth of a granddaughter who is given her name.

Title: 845. Los mujeriegos
description: Three hard-partying cowboys go to Mexico City for one last fling before entering into arranged marriages back home.

Title: 846. Cuando Mexico canta
description: Lorenzo Inclán, a famous Mexican songwriter, is torn between helping a girl become a famous singer or having a romantic relationship with her.

Title: 849. Pekka ja Pätkä miljonääreinä
description: Pekka Puupää unexpectedly inherits a million-dollar fortune and with it, Pekka starts running a toy factory with his friend Pätkä.

Title: 850. Happy Bums
description: Two jobbers meet an actor, when the sneak in a theater. The actor is homeless and they invite him to stay with them He will know and love their neighbor, who is studying classical dance.

Title: 851. ¡Viva lo imposible!
description: A civil servant quits his job and engages with his family in a circus life, searching for fun and excitement. There they will find out that some such artists long for a different, less adventurous life.

Title: 852. Kala
description: There are two stories in this movie. One treats the human side, the things happening to a man in a war, the pain and pressure on his nerves and courage and how he copes with everything in order for him to survive and not lose his sanity. The other story deals with the animal side, the things happening to a dog who gradually loses everything he knew and loved and is even faced with a threat to its existence itself. To survive the dog has to forget everything it was taught and hold dear, fear the man and its tricks and become wild and free again.

Title: 853. The Money
description: About a poor farmer whose bid for a better life ends up bringing calamity to his family. At the urging of loan shark Eok Jo (Choi Nam Hyun), Bong Su (Kim Seung Ho) sells his cows to start a business but he loses everything to a conman (No Kyung Hee). Bong Su accidentally kills Eok Jo in a fight and takes his money, and the police trace the crime back to Bong Su's son.

Title: 856. Andzamb tchanachum em
description: The first movie of the trilogy about Armenian Bolshevik revolutionary Simon Ter-Petrosyan, known as Kamo.

Title: 857. Kievlyanka
description: The story of the growing up of the orphan Gali between the Revolution and the Great Patriotic War. Large-scale historical drama with Nina Ivanova.

Title: 858. Der lachende Vagabund
description: Gestresst von den familiären Machenschaften unternehmen zwei Männer einen abenteuerlichen Ausflug.

Title: 859. Zonga, el ángel diabólico
description: A medical researcher arrives at a cursed island and falls in love with an indigenous priestess.

Title: 862. Mito Kômon man'yûki
description: A historical figure, Tokugawa Mitsukuni is a Daimyo, a 17th century governor, famous to the point of having inspired a popular story, Mito Mitsukuni Man'yuki, itself already adapted several times for the cinema.

Title: 863. Piya Milan
description: A king faces deception and challenges when he refuses to permit his daughter to get married to another king.

Title: 864. Playing on the Rainbow
description: The school counselor Vanja believe neither in love, marriage or a woman's subservient role to the man. One day she meets the student Björn. Their romance is full of problems. Along comes a man from Vanjas past.

Title: 865. Rowzanehe omid
description: Mohsen who has won the lottery lost his suitcase and another woman finds it by chance opening a cafe. Later they meet each other but Mohsen has other plans for his life.

Title: 869. Kaki kuda
description: The movie is about the gambling horse racing. Although the film played in the form of comedy is filled with examples This film surrounds a wealthy tycoon who is addicted to horse racing and horse betting. (He lives in Holland Hill, a rich man's enclave) The tycoon's driver impersonates him to get hitched to his love interest. His sauce at the horse stables is a friend of the driver, and he too pretends to be a doctor and falls for the lady he administers "treatment" on.

Title: 870. Asu o kakeru otoko
description: Daishiro, a former boxer, is asked by his family member Morihiko to go to an inn to pick up a winning lottery ticket worth 2 million yen. When he arrives at the inn, he finds the yakuza threatening the innkeeper and trying to rob the inn.

Title: 873. Una gira A.T.M.
description: This film is a compilation of four (4) short films in a series starring the Ruffino family. The films consists of basic comedy plots that provide plenty of opportunities for the Ruffino family to sing.

Title: 874. Le joueur
description: The game was his curse.

Title: 875. El farol de la ventana
description: Antonio falls in love with Marena, the daughter of a blind woman who believes Antonio is her missing son.

Title: 876. Malvarosa
description: Story of a family's struggles in life. Rosa lives in the slums near the railroad tracks, with her mother and five brothers. Her mother wallows in guilt and depression, when her drunkard father is run over by a train.

Title: 877. Glow of the Firefly
description: Tose got incredibly lucky to go from being the peasants' daughter to the owner of a famous inn. But her husband doesn't support her, they have no children of their own, and there is unrest in the country that threatens their business.

Title: 878. O Barbeiro Que Se Vira
description: Barber likes to help everybody in town. Now, he's trying to help a young couple in love defeat the girl's tutor, who is against the romance.

Title: 879. Una golfa
description: Trumpet-player in a club band falls for a streety young woman.

Title: 881. Im Prater blüh'n wieder die Bäume
description: While visiting Vienna's famed Prater, Archduke Peter Ferdinand meets Lixie, the daughter of a government official. He falls in love with her--creating a complicated situation for Lixie, who has declared her love for her handsome young piano teacher, Toni. Toni's hopes for a position at the Court Opera--needed so that he can propose to Lixie--are dashed because he lacks a powerful patron. Lixie joins the Archduke for an evening the "Red Salon" in the Hotel Sacher, where she convinces the Archduke to extend his patronage to her "brother" Toni. This leads to embarrassing entanglements all around, but also to a romantic encounter that touches both of them. The next morning, the entire matter becomes a political scandal: Viennese society cannot let an affair between the Archduke and a commoner go unnoticed. Lixie's friend and neighbor Mizzi, a dancer at the Court Ballet, steps forward to help untangle the matter.

Title: 883. O Camelô da Rua Larga
description: Street vendor, who lives on the run from the police and the pension owner he owes, gets a bag full of money in a fight that will bring him big problems.

Title: 884. Abana
description: Two friends, one rich and one poor, are torn apart by love, jealousy, and the Partition of India. Misunderstandings separate them, but years later, a hidden act of sacrifice leads to forgiveness and reunion.

Title: 885. Akujo no kisetsu
description: A rich skinflint, hated by his common wife (a previous Geisha) and his nephew, tries to follow his selfish desires and keep his wealth of diamonds safe; while there are separate plots being formed to kill him for his money: one by his wife and her ex-lover, and the other by his stepdaughter and the nephew. Gradually things get out of control and so everybody turns against everybody else.

Title: 886. Wu hai ye hang
description: 1300 people are aboard a passenger ship in danger of sinking on a trip from Shanghai to Ningbo.

Title: 887. Der Lotterieschwede
description: Johan Jönsson, a quarry-man, lives a meager life on the island Bornholm with his wife and children. He buys a lottery ticket and has great hopes of a happy and good life. But his fortune is not forthcoming.

Title: 888. Sie kannten sich alle
description: A car factory in the GDR. During a test ride there is a major accident. One driver is dead, another is seriously injured. The investigation reveals: sabotage.

Title: 889. Hantu Kubor
description: Continuation of the film Hantu Jerangkung, Mak Hitam (Habsah Buang) comes back to life as a grave ghost and creates chaos in the village if Musa (Aziz Jaafar) does not obey her wishes. When Tok Penghulu (S. Kadarisman) and the villagers are no longer powerless to fight Mak Hitam's tribe, they ask for help from Tok Pawang (Malek Sutan Muda) who really knows about the origins of Mak Hitam.

Title: 892. La môme aux boutons
description: The Count De Rochambeau wants to marry Mireille but she likes Etienne. The sister of Etienne, nicknamed "the girl with buttons" schemed with a friend to pose as a Russian princess to seduce the count and allow the marriage of his brother with Mireille.

Title: 893. Slag för slag
description: The boxing gala at Nya Ullevi in Göteborg Sunday, September 14, 1958, where the main attraction is the match in heavyweight between Ingemar Johansson, Sweden and Eddie Machen, USA.

Title: 896. På tokt med terna
description: Some Boy Scouts get hold of a sailboat with which they travel down the coast. They come on the trail of some smugglers, whom they capture after several dramatic episodes.

Title: 899. Tuloy ang ligaya
description: The most impossible dreams of a great musical come true with the nation's to radio stars, stage and television names.

Title: 900. Fifth District
description: Five men commit a robbery and flee each by their side. Later they meet in a local to distribute the money. While they wait for Juan, who is the one who takes the booty, each of them begins to imagine what he will do with his part. But the waiting is prolonged, and the thieves begin to suspect that their companion will never come. They remember then how they knew him and how the events happened until that day.

Title: 901. Der Greifer
description: German actor Hans Albers shot himself to fame in 1930 with the movie "Der Greifer." Here Albers plays Sgt. Harry Cross. Representing Scotland Yard he mingles with the cream of British society to bring a murderer to justice. Greeting everyone with off-handed cheerfulness, Albers is able to put the culprit "at ease" long enough to tighten the noose. He also wins the girl of his dreams, Dolly Mooreland, fetchingly played by Charlotte Susa. Hans Albers was the single biggest male movie star in Germany between 1930 and 1945 and one of the most popular German actors of the twentieth century. Albers starred in a 1958 remake of the film once again playing the role of the retiring police superintendent.

Title: 902. Ten Days to Tulara
description: A bandido forces a pilot to fly him and some gold bars to the coast, but when the plane is shot down, they make the trip cross-country, accompanied by the bandit's nubile daughter, leaving a trail of love and death behind.

Title: 904. Historias de Madrid
description: In Madrid, both the owner of a building and its tenants have asked help to San Nicolás : the owner for the house to break down so he can build a modern one with higher rents, the neighbors for its endurance so they won't loose their homes.

Title: 906. Hoppla, jetzt kommt Eddie
description: Sailor Eddie is ordered to take care of four South African beauties. However an international criminal organization kidnaps one of them: Juanita Perez, daughter of the inventor of a new, dramatically cheap, kind of fuel. Since the police doesn't believe him, Eddie has to chase the villains himself.

Title: 907. Fratse in die Vloot
description: In order to earn a regular living, two unsuccessful entertainers join the navy. They soon find themselves unwittingly involved in a scheme to smuggle stolen diamonds out of the country.

Title: 908. L'école des cocottes
description: A young Parisian woman attends a school for coquettes in order to rise in society.

Title: 912. Obsessive Snake
description: Utaji heard that her ex-lover Seijirou would get married to Ochiyo a daughter of Ise-ya. She murdered Ochiyo and took over the Ise-ya's shop with Hikoroku a head clerk of Ise-ya. Moreover Utaji killed Hikoroku.

Title: 913. Villa Alegre
description: Two truck drivers stop at an apparently normal coastal village, to find it is not normal at all.

Title: 914. Madame et son auto
description: Sophie Dirondel, history teacher at the Saint-Cloison-sur-Ermoise, wins the jackpot of a lottery, a 2CV. The good-natured woman is both happy and slightly upset, as she doe not have her driving-license. But she decides to take driving lessons and although she does not prove very gifted she manages to pass the test. She grasps the opportunity to achieve one of her sweetest dreams and, proudly sitting behind her wheel, heads for the City of Light. Alone in Paris, she gets to know Victor Martini, a smooth operator. The man who, in real fact, is the leader of a gang, has no problem bamboozling the naive woman.

Title: 924. Le souffle du désir
description: Daniel Bellanger, a night-club crooner, is a basically straight,honest man. He has just married Christiane, a cashier in a Montmartre hotel and his main objective in life is to live happily with his wife and Pierrot, the son she had of a former union. Unfortunately Daniel accepts the offer of his old friend Freddy to run a gambling den. The place is frequented by a host of dubious guys, among whom a hood named Mario. The latter finds Christiane to his liking and soon shows he is prepared to do anything to take her away from Daniel, including kidnapping little Pierrot...

Title: 928. Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
description: A psychiatric-clinic medical director runs some tests on two patients, the Ragionier Antonio Vignanelli and Cavalier Peppino Caprioli, so they must retrieve some memories of family life in order to understand their mental illness.

Title: 929. Blow Your Own Trumpet
description: A young lad wants to play cornet and despite the efforts of a rival, wins a competition and a place in the local band by sheer grit and perseverance.

Title: 930. Ismail Yassine fil Dimashq
description: An insurance company notices that many of its clients have mysteriously disappeared, so it sends two agents to Beirut to uncover the truth.

Title: 931. Alegria de Viver
description: The boss of Gilberto, an exemplary employee, wants to marry him with his daughter, Elisabeth. But her cousin, an unattractive girl, appears to meet him. Gilberto, who leads a hectic life, knows Betty, independent girl by whom one falls in love. In the end, she discovers that she is the boss's daughter.

Title: 933. Mariannes bryllup eller hævnen er bitter
description: Jørgen is a gambler - always short of money. He marries a rich man's daughter and gambles in the inn, while she waits for him in the honeymoon cabin. Love?

Title: 934. Shamus
description: Engaging comedy about a young boy who has an embarrassing spell placed on him by a leprechaun.

Title: 935. Andreyka
description: The story of a boy from Petrograd, the events of which took place during the inter-revolutionary July days of 1917.

Title: 937. The Abandoned Swords
description: A will gets stolen and then the chase for the lost will starts. This result in lots of love troubles and a lot of fighting.

Title: 938. Horká láska
description: The elder son of the farmer Marunác dies as a result of a work accident. His wife and younger brother fall in love and try to break free from the tyranny of their despotic father.

Title: 940. Zenigata heiji torimono hikae: hachi-nin no hanayome
943. Monyeo
description: Although his father forbids it, a young woman cannot live without seeing her mother who has been thrown out of the house and banned from having contact with the family.

Title: 948. Amagi shinjû: Tengoku ni musubu koi
950. Ankôru watto monogatari utsukushiki aishû
description: A Japanese artist (Ikebe), who had won the favor of the Cambodian royal family when he rescued their daughter during World War II, returns and falls for the now-grown princess, though neither realizes the other's identity.

Title: 952. Tsuki no kagebôshi: Yama o tobu kohime
953. Com a Mão na Massa
description: While his uncle is traveling, an irresponsible young man spends a fortune on sprees with friends and lady sweethearts, but when the creditors start pressuring for cash, he pretends to lose his memory, although not fooling his fiancée.

Title: 959. Melpo
description: Melpo is a sensual woman stealing men's hearts and playing games with them.

Title: 961. Sone Ki Chidiya
description: An impoverished orphan is first abused by her extended family, and then exploited after she becomes popular and wealthy.

Title: 962. Yo quiero ser artista
description: Adalberto, a mailman accidentally walks into a movie scene, leading the director to secretly keep filming him as part of the production without his knowledge.

Title: 963. Links of Justice
description: Edgar Mills and his mistress Stella, a failed actress, plot to murder Edgar's wealthy wife Clare. But Edgar ends up dead, his throat cut. Clare becomes prime suspect and is put on trial.

Title: 964. Cigarettes, Whiskey and Wild Women
description: Martine runs a sports center for women ,but they are short of the readies .To avoid seizure,she turns her health club into a nightclub with plenty of whiskey and wild women.

Title: 965. Seven Guns to Mesa
description: A band of outlaws, led by "Papa" Clellan, hold up in a ghost town as they plan an attack on a wagon train loaded with gold. The unexpected arrival of a stagecoach forces the gang to hold the passengers and driver as hostages. The later arrival of a wanderer, John Trey, sets in motion events not in "Papa" Clellan's original plan.

Title: 966. Satan's Satellites
description: Feature version of the 1952 serial "Zombies of the Stratosphere. " Alien invaders plan to use a Hydrogen bomb to blast Earth out its orbit so Mars can replace it.

Title: 967. In the Money
description: Sach is hired as the companion for a poodle on an ocean voyage from New York to London. What he doesn't know is that the people who hired him are actually diamond smugglers, and there is a cache of diamonds hidden in the poodle's coat.

Title: 969. Cerf-volant du bout du monde
description: This interesting little French film is set in a run-down suburb of Paris. It's about a group of bored children making mischief to fill the days (eg sticking a cat up a tree and then calling the fire brigade so they can watch them get it down!) One of them has a Chinese kite, with a message on a piece of paper in Chinese on it. His mates try to grab it to sell to an antique shop. One night, one of the boys and his sister are visited by a mysterious Chinaman and are promptly floated off on their bed to China in their pyjamas. The Chinaman clicks his fingers and they appear once again in their everyday clothes, and have all sorts of adventures in China.

Title: 970. Sucedió en México
description: After plastic surgery, a woman poses as someone else to examine her relationships with both her husband and lover.

Title: 971. A Hero in His Slippers
description: After forty years of service, the Nation is about to immortalise an honest Greek Army general who is unaware that an unscrupulous duo is planning to make a profit behind his back. Will the gallant veteran teach them a lesson in respect?

Title: 972. 12 O'Clock
description: Bani Chowdhury and solicitor Ajoy Kumar are deeply in love with each other. But their world comes crashing down when Bani's cousin, Maya is found dead in the first class compartment at a railway terminus in Bombay. Bani who had gone to the station to receive Maya, is charged with the murder. A distraught Ajoy with the help of his assistant Motilal Sharma begins to comb the country for every available clue. And just when everything seems lost he gets a breakthrough.

Title: 973. Phagun
description: Banani is the daughter of a rich man, brought up by gypsies after he abandoned her due to the grief of losing his wife. She and Bijon, the son of a landlord, fall in love when the gypsies come to his father's estate.

Title: 974. Davy
description: The Mad Morgans are a family song and dance act touring the British music halls. Young Davy is the star of the act, but should he stay with his family or strike out on his own?

Title: 975. Le dritte
description: The affected clothing merchant Ofelia, the naive housewife Rina, and the outspoken nurse Edna meet randomly at a police station and discover that they share a failed sentimental life.

Title: 977. Le désert de Pigalle
description: A priest working in the Pigalle district saves some street girls from the vice bosses.

Title: 978. El rayo de Sinaloa (La venganza de Heraclio Bernal)
description: Continuation of "Aquí está Heraclio Bernal". Don Jesús Bernal, his wife and their five children after a year and a half of having left the town, have returned asking Mr. Lomeli for work in the mine.

Title: 979. Parvarish
description: After an hospital accident, a wealthy male is compelled to adopt a prostitute's son.

Title: 980. Angel in a Taxi
description: Marietto is a very lively and creative orphaned child, housed in a boarding school of nuns. One day, while browsing a newspaper, he sees a photo of a beautiful opera house dancer, Camilla, and is convinced that she is her mother.

Title: 981. La morocha
description: A prostitute persecuted by the police, receives the interested protection of a greedy merchant. He takes refuge in his house one night and meets his nephew, a sensitive boy who wants to be a musician.

Title: 982. Kinder der Berge
description: Josef Rainer is a road worker in a mountain village in Liechtenstein. His wife Marianne works as a waitress in a restaurant to improve the meager housekeeping money. Some people ask themselves why she has married that poor devil since she could have married into money. But she stays to the keen wood carver. He works out fantastic objects of tree roots, but villagers jeer at him. The family dreams to get a cow of their own to be more independent. One day Josef scrapes together all savings and goes to the cattle market. Due to lack of money, a clever farmer palms a skinny, sick cow off on him. The children Hansli and his friend Ludmila take the cow to their heart. Ludmila even lends her name to the animal. Some time later Josef falls from a mountain and is unable to work for a long time. So a decision is made that cow Ludmila which produces no milk has to be slaughtered. To prevent it, Hansli takes her secretly to an alpine pasture. A miracle happens: Cow Ludmila produces more milk than any other cow after eating a special herb. The villagers ascribe this to the wooden statue of virgin Mary which Josef had made out of a tree root. He can thus sell it to a fair price.

Title: 983. Tabarin
description: Jacques Forestier, also a choreographer, an art decorator and a stage producer, is the very competent manager of "Tabarin", a renowned Parisian music-hall. A hard worker, he always wants the best for the public, at the expense of his health. He is assisted in his task by his wife Rosine and his lively secretary Mimi. Chance has it that one of the dancers he auditions for a new show is Florence, his former lover. He doesn't want her in the show but the spiteful belle has a rich influential protector who imposes her anyway. Some time later, Jacques falls victim of a heart attack...

Title: 984. Girl in the Woods
description: Lumbering tale of lumbermen challenging the ownership of valuable woodlands.

Title: 985. Wolf Dog
description: Just paroled from a prison term for manslaughter, ex-Marine Jim Hughes makes a new start with his wife Ellen and ten-year-old son Paul, on a ranch given him by his old Corps commander. Krivak, a vicious neighbor, threatens to take the land away from him after Jim refuses to sell. He instigates a fight between his dog Thunder and Paul's much smaller dog, which is killed. Later, the grieving Paul finds a wild puppy, half dog and half wolf, and Jim lets him keep it. Preparing to take his herd to market, Jim finds his fences cut and his herd stolen. He is accosted by two escaped convicts, Trent and Hawkins, who knew Jim in prison, and they force him to take them in. Trent sends Paul into town for some medicine, where his now-grown dog, Wolf Dog, and Thunder get into a fight and Thunder is killed. Krivac goes to the ranch gunning for Jim.

Title: 986. Hadaka no taiyô
description: A young, struggling couple are making every sacrifice so they will one day in the not-too-distant-future, have enough money to get married. As they have agreed on this procedure, it comes as a shock to the young woman to find out from her husband-to-be that he just loaned all the money they had saved to a friend. She is understandably miffed, and a big disagreement results. But after some time goes by, she discovers why the friend needed the money so badly, and the couple are back on solid footing again.

Title: 987. Sacrée jeunesse
description: A wealthy old man is not in a hurry to see the next world.A stay in Switzerland puts new life into him,thanks to a miracle doctor.

Title: 988. Der eiserne Gustav
description: Gustav Hartmann is in trouble. Because of the new taxis he doesn't get many passengers in his horse-drawn carriage. To prove what he and his horse are capable of, he starts a trip from Berlin to Paris.

Title: 989. The Toughest Gun in Tombstone
description: Matt Sloane is sent from Texas to Arizona to tame Tombstone where a gang of outlaws deals with cattle and silver. One of them killed his wife.

Title: 990. Blood Arrow
description: A young Mormon woman and a scout guide a shipment of smallpox serum through Indian terrain.

Title: 991. Flaming Frontier
description: Army officer whose parents are white and Indian tries to avert an Indian war.

Title: 992. Música en la noche
description: An ingenious actor has an idea of making musical numbers without a dialogue when he arrives with a violin and a ladder.

Title: 993. Ballad of the Ming Tombs Reservoir
description: The film takes place during work on the water reservoir, outside Beijing's Ming Tombs, in 1958 at the beginning of the Great Leap Forward. The film follows how workers and leaders are working together to get it done. The film's final 25 minutes is a future interpretation of how it will look like 20 years after it has been completed with the water reservoir.

Title: 994. The Bank Raiders
description: Terry, a small-time hoodlum, is the driver in a successful bank robbery. He gets his share of the loot and is told to lie low. Instead, he goes on the town with Della, a gorgeous, but greedy, party girl. Terry is questioned and released by police. Bernie Shelton, the gang boss, kidnaps the only witness. Then he sends his goon (Linders) to kill Terry, but Linders gets shot instead. With police after him, Terry seeks shelter in Della's apartment. When Della learns that Shelton, a man who spurned her, was behind the raid, she promises to run away with Terry, if he'll confront boss at gun-point to get the rest of the loot.

Title: 995. Frontier Gun
description: Small-town sheriff discovers that gun-fighting is the only way to clean up the town.

Title: 996. A Gift for Heidi
description: Orphan Heidi lives with her grandfather in the Alps. She receives three wooden figures, learns life lessons about faith, charity and hope, enters a friend in a contest, and helps rescue honeymooners trapped on a mountain.

Title: 997. The Rawhide Trail
description: Jess Brady and Rupe Pardee are in jail in Gunsight, Texas, blamed for leading a wagon train into a Comanche ambush, and about to be hanged. They protest their innocence and claim that the Indians want to kill them also. The Comanches attack the jail in an effort to capture the prisoners, but are driven off the soldiers of the garrison led by the Captain. Expecting another attack, the Captain and a small detail of men move the prisoners out of town in a wagon, but they are under constant surveillance by the Comanches. The detail arrives at a way station the same time as a stage coach carrying Marsha Collins, and her fiancée, Farley Durand, a government supply officer. All are trapped in the station which is under constant attack by the Indians. Brady and Durand resume a personal battle that dates back to the Civil War when they served together. The wounded Captain decides to gamble on Brady and Pardee, their experience being the only hope for an escape. In the escape battle, it is revealed that Durand was responsible for the attack on the wagon train, and not Brady and Pardee.

Title: 998. Cuatro copas
description: An Argentine movie star falls in love with a humble plumber who sings Mexican folk songs.

Title: 999. The Csardas Princess
description: As boy, Emmerich Kalman feels more at home in the country with gypsy musicians then in his stuffy family. His soulless uncle puts him to college, but disapproves of music even as a hobby, so Emmerich rather gives up law then the piano. Talent soon gets his career going, all the way to royal and imperial capitals Budapest and Vienna. Women fall for him, but aristocratic partners win out when it gets serious, so Emmerich is to find love with the likes of a coat checks girl and actress-dancer Vera.

Title: 1000. La rebelión de la sierra
description: Third and last film in the trilogy about Heraclio Bernal. Heraclio continues his fight against the Federales in the Juarista era.
